jobs.title: Real Estate Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**WHY JOIN ALO?**

Mindful movement. It's at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it's our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That's the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

**OVERVIEW**

The Real Estate Project Coordinator plays a critical role in the Global expansion and store development lifecycle. This individual manages the administrative, due diligence, and internal cross-functional approval workflows. They act as the central hub between internal stakeholders (Real Estate, Legal, Construction, Finance, Store Design, Store Operations) and external partners (brokers, landlords, developers). This role ensures all site packages meet corporate standards, adhere to timelines, and move seamlessly through the Real Estate Committee (REC) approval process. They support the planning, execution, and day-to-day coordination of real estate projects, helping keep day-to-day activities and projects organized and on track as well as consolidating and preparing market & store visit materials. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Compile, audit, and maintain comprehensive site approval packages, for executive review, including market demographics, lease summaries, sales projections, site plans, preliminary construction budgets, proforma and deal terms.
* Manage the agenda, tracking logs, and presentation materials for weekly or monthly REC meetings.
* Track conditions of approval post-REC and ensure all contingencies are satisfied prior to legal documentation.
* Launch projects internally with design and construction partners.
* Work with market analysis tools to gather required demographic information and full portfolio market plan development to support of the RE Directors
* Act as initial point of contact for Real Estate with landlords and obtain project set-up sheets, drawings, photos, Landlord work schedules, tenant criteria, and other materials
* Collaborate with Architect/Design and Construction teams on management of Landlord construction documents, Landlord work schedules and other construction related items
* Assist Real Estate Directors in tracking possession timing and collaborate with Construction on Landlord work completion
* Obtain and document Landlord Possession letters
* Manage files, organize paperwork and responsible for minutes/REC Outcomes share out internally
* Managing incoming LL contacts, and schedule meetings as needed to facilitate store pipeline
* Assist in preparation for ICSC conferences and other team activities

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* BA Degree in a related field
* 3-5 years of experience, preferably in Real Estate
* Intermediate to advanced Word, Excel and PowerPoint
* Understanding of the fundamental budgeting processes and controls
* Strong administration/organization / interpersonal skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to prioritize workload, manage and adhere to deadlines and work autonomously as well as be a team player

The base salary range for this position is $85,000-$95,000 per year which represents the current range for the base salary for this exempt position. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. As such, on occasion and when applicable, there is the possibility that the final, agreed-upon base salary may be outside of the upper end of the range. Please also note the range listed is just one component of the company's total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a PTO policy, and many other progressive benefits.

jobs.title: Social Media and Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About MILKBARN**

MILKBARN creates baby and children's clothing, accessories, nursery essentials and gifts inspired by childhood imagination and original prints. We want to build lasting connections with families through warm, distinctive brand storytelling.

milkbarnkids.com

**The role**

We are looking for a Social Media & Influencer Marketing coordinator to bring MILKBARN's stories to life for U.S. audiences. You will own social content planning and execution, creator partnerships and community engagement. This hands-on role includes writing, everyday video production and performance analysis to grow brand awareness, meaningful engagement and qualified website traffic.

**What you will do**

· **Plan social content.** Build a monthly calendar around our audience, brand voice, product launches and seasonal moments. Prioritize Instagram and develop other relevant channels according to business needs and performance.

· **Create content.** Turn original prints, fabric details, styling, gifting and everyday family moments into compelling stories. Write English copy, shoot and edit everyday short-form video, and develop clear briefs for professional shoots.

· **Manage channels and community.** Publish content, engage with comments and messages, and maintain a consistent visual identity and voice. Capture customer insights and route order or service issues to the appropriate colleagues.

· **Run creator partnerships.** Identify parenting, family and lifestyle creators whose audiences fit the brand. Manage outreach, gifting, briefs, reviews and publishing, tracking timelines and results within agreed budgets.

· **Build a usable content library.** Source authentic customer stories and user-generated content. Coordinate usage permissions, partnership disclosures and relevant image releases, and organize assets for social, e-commerce and other marketing activity.

· **Support launches and campaigns.** Coordinate with e-commerce on product availability, campaign timing, destination pages and tracking links. Create content that helps people discover products and take the next step toward purchase.

· **Measure and improve.** Analyze relevant reach, video viewing, saves and shares, audience growth, website traffic and creator results. Recommend changes to content and partnerships, and share audience insights with e-commerce and merchandising colleagues.

**What you bring**

· 3+ years of experience in social media, content or influencer marketing, including consumer brand accounts serving the U.S. market.

· Strong practical knowledge of Instagram and the ability to take work from idea and copy through production, publishing and review. Sound judgment about adapting content for other platforms.

· Excellent English writing, storytelling and visual judgment, with the ability to translate product features into natural, engaging content that fits the brand.

· The ability to independently shoot and edit everyday short-form video and create simple visual assets using tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe or equivalents.

· Experience identifying, contacting and managing creators, assessing audience fit and content quality, and reviewing performance using platform insights and tracked links.

· Strong project coordination and communication skills. Ability to work on-site at our future LA office with regular in-office attendance and participate in product and content shoots.

**Preferred experience**

· Experience with baby or children's apparel, children's products, parenting or family lifestyle brands, with an understanding of U.S. parents, caregivers and gift shoppers.

· Relevant creator relationships or examples of growth through content series, community programs or creator partnerships.

· Experience with Pinterest, TikTok, Facebook or other relevant channels, or with paid-social creative, licensed creator assets and small-scale content promotion tests.

**How success will be measured**

Success will be evaluated through content quality and consistency, target-audience reach, meaningful engagement, community growth, qualified website traffic, and the content and commercial value of creator partnerships. Specific goals will reflect channel baselines, budgets and production resources.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Parental leave

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Glendale, CA 91206

jobs.description:
Tennis Channel is seeking a Production Coordinator to support the planning and execution of live remote events and studio shows, both domestic and international. As a key member of the Production Management team, this role works closely with the Production Manager and leads our team of Production Assistants across more than 320 live days of tennis each year. We're looking for a highly organized, proactive, and quick-thinking professional with strong communication and interpersonal skills who represents Tennis Channel professionally with crews, vendors, and partners. This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA.

**In this role, you will do the following:**

* Serve as a key point of contact for production teams on remote productions, working with crews, vendors, venues, and internal departments.
* Coordinate on-location logistics from start to finish, including crew movements, equipment shipments, and vendor communication.
* Partner with the crewing team to source and hire control rooms, stage, and remote crews.
* Research and book locations, manage permitting, and process related paperwork, including vendor documents, releases, certificates of insurance, and payments.
* Partner with the Travel team to book flights, hotels, and rental vehicles.
* Ensure crew onboarding is complete before filming and support crews on location.
* Support the Production Manager in coordinating studio staff, facilities, and daily operations.
* Supervise, schedule, and support our team of Production Assistants.
* Collaborate with production teams to ensure assigned productions meet the network's creative and technical objectives.
* Help train new Production Assistants on department processes and procedures.
* Create, maintain, and quality-check production books, call sheets, daily schedules, shoot schedules, and planning documents.
* Manage daily production communications, including shoot emails and schedule updates.
* Partner with the Production Accountant and other departments to communicate budget considerations and crew assignments, create purchase orders, and ensure timely processing of crew paperwork.
* Help manage inventory, organize supplies, and coordinate shipping.

* 3â€“5 years of experience as a production coordinator or production assistant in sports or entertainment production.
* Proven ability to multitask, adapt to a fast-paced environment, and manage several productions and deadlines at once.
* Ability to adapt and thrive in constantly changing environments with unpredictable challenges and a wide range of personalities.
* Experience leading or mentoring production assistants.
* Enthusiasm for hands-on work and the resourcefulness to roll up your sleeves and make things happen.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Experience with Smartsheet and with crewing and scheduling software preferred.
* Familiarity with location permitting, certificates of insurance, and purchase orders preferred.
* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Flexible schedule that includes some nights, weekends, and holidays as production needs require. The tennis season runs January through November, with the heaviest workload from May through September.

* Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and move large equipment cases.

Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that puts the consumer first—seamlessly integrating live and on-demand content across platforms.

At the intersection of cutting-edge technology and trusted storytelling, this is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming at one of the most pivotal moments in media. We’re assembling a world-class team to deliver on that vision—and we’re just getting started.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a Marketing Coordinator to provide high-level administrative and operational support to the CMO and help drive the day-to-day effectiveness of the broader marketing organization. In this highly visible role, you will manage a complex and fast-moving calendar, coordinate executive travel and meetings, and serve as a trusted liaison across the DTC organization, senior FOX leadership, and external partners. Because many of our biggest moments happen outside of traditional business hours, this role requires occasional flexibility to support evenings and weekends during live programming and marquee events.

You will also play an important role in keeping our Los Angeles office running smoothly, partnering across teams to support office operations, facilities, onboarding, meetings, and events. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, resourceful, and comfortable balancing executive support with hands-on office operations in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

**A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Seamlessly manage a complex, fast-changing calendar for the CMO, strategically prioritizing commitments, navigating multiple time zones, and proactively resolving scheduling conflicts.

* Coordinate detailed domestic and international travel itineraries, including flights, accommodations, and ground transportation, and complete expense reports in a timely manner.
* Plan and execute internal and external leadership meetings, all-hands meetings, and team-building events.
* Serve as a primary point of contact and operational liaison between the CMO, internal teams, senior FOX leadership, and external partners.
* Oversee day-to-day local office operations, including vendor relationships, office supply inventories, catering orders, and facility maintenance requests.
* Oversee conference room schedules, room readiness, and AV and meeting technology on the floor to ensure the smooth execution of daily team and executive meetings.
* Partner with HR to facilitate and streamline the onboarding process for new hires across the marketing team.
* Greet office visitors, manage guest access, and coordinate with building management and security regarding facilities, access badges, and safety protocols.
* Draft, proofread, and format executive communications, slide decks, status updates, and meeting notes as required.

**WHAT YOU WILL NEED**

* Experience providing executive administrative support, along with operational or facilities management experience, ideally within digital media, technology, software engineering, or streaming environments.
* Proven track record of working collaboratively and cross-functionally with administrative peers across teams or business units.
* High degree of professionalism, maturity, and discretion when handling sensitive business and personnel information.
* Outstanding organizational skills, acute attention to detail, and a proven ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a welcoming, customer-service-oriented approach to managing workplace needs and external guests.
* Hands-on experience coordinating facilities, office services, catering, and vendor relationships.
* Occasional flexibility to work evenings and weekends in support of live programming and marquee events.
* Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

**NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER**

* Experience supporting senior executives within a fast-paced direct-to-consumer, streaming, media, or technology organization.
* Experience supporting a growing or evolving team where priorities, processes, and operational needs can change quickly.
* Familiarity with coordinating large-scale team meetings, executive events, and employee engagement activities.

jobs.title: Sales Account Coordinator, Amazon
jobs.description:
Day to day life has room for improvement.

That was our basic thinking when we founded Simplehuman in 2000. Our mission is to bring high-performance innovation to basic but essential tasks in our daily routine. Through new technologies, meticulous engineering and an obsession for improvement, we find new and better ways to achieve basic but important daily tasks.

**About the role**

We are seeking an Amazon Sales Coordinator to support the day to day operations of Simplehuman's Amazon business across the US (Amazon.com) and Canada (Amazon.ca). Reporting to the Sr. Amazon Account Manager of North America, you will keep listings accurate, purchase orders moving, inventory healthy and reporting on time, so the account team can focus on growth and strategy. This role is based in our Torrance headquarters, and the ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized and comfortable managing many moving parts across two marketplaces.

**Responsibilities**

* Support the day to day management of the Amazon US and Canada accounts through Vendor Central and Seller Central.
* Process and track purchase orders, confirm shipments and follow up on open issues with Amazon, the Operations team and our US and CA distribution centers.
* Maintain product listings, pricing, images and A+ Content, and submit catalog updates and new item setups for both marketplaces.
* Monitor inventory levels, fill rates and in-stock position, and flag risks to the account managers and planning team.
* Research and resolve chargebacks, shortages, deductions and compliance issues, and file disputes and support cases as needed.
* Coordinate promotions and deals (SnS, coupons and Prime Day/holiday events), including setup, tracking and post-event recaps.
* Support Amazon Advertising campaigns (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display) with campaign setup, budget tracking and performance reporting.
* Prepare weekly and monthly sales, inventory and advertising reports, and help analyze trends and competitive activity.
* Act as a point of contact for vendor manager and Seller Support communication, keeping cases organized and moving to resolution.
* Partner with marketing, creative and customer service teams to keep brand standards and product information consistent across the US and Canada.

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing or a related field.
* 3 - 5 years of experience supporting an Amazon business, in e-commerce operations or in retail account coordination.
* Hands-on experience with Amazon Vendor Central and/or Seller Central; Amazon Advertising experience a plus.
* Experience with Amazon.com and Amazon.ca or another international Amazon marketplace a strong plus.
* Working knowledge of purchase orders, EDI, retailer compliance and chargeback management.
* Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP) and comfort working with large data sets.
* Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Clear, professional communication skills and a proactive, team-first approach.
* Experience in premium consumer products or housewares a strong plus.

  

**About Us**

We're a mature company with the soul of a start-up. We value ingenuity, precise communications, fast iteration and scrappiness. Our teams are tight-knit with a work hard, play hard tradition – we take pride in individual and team success and push boundaries to make the best products. And we only build products we love to use ourselves. Great benefits, competitive compensation, and generous Simplehuman product discounts.

With clients such as Burger King, Lidl, Harvest Snaps and Skyscanner (to name drop a few) our aim is to be the biggest social agency in the world.

The agency is growing at a rapid rate, but we’re only just getting started. In 2026, we have ambitious plans to truly become the stand-out social agency in the UK, the US, and beyond. We have a strong platform for growth and have made great strides forward – now we really want to take things to the next level.

**About the role:**

We're looking for an Account Manager to join our team. You'll sit between the Senior Account Director and the Social executive below you. Owning the day-to-day running of your accounts, keeping campaigns on track and making sure the team has what they need to deliver.

This is a role for someone organized, culturally switched on and genuinely passionate about social media. You'll be hands-on across client communications, creative, production and influencer work streams.

**The job:**

**Client Services**

* Serve as the main day-to-day contact for clients, building strong working relationships under the guidance of the Account Director
* Lead scheduled and ad hoc client calls and deliver presentations with a passion for storytelling
* Keep status documents updated daily and ensure the wider team is informed of actions and priorities
* Manage campaigns end-to-end - timelines, budgets, client expectations and internal resource
* Support the Account Director on budget development and reconciliation at project close
* Support executives with weekly, monthly and quarterly reportingCreative, Strategy & Production
* Stay immersed in social culture and proactively flag reactive opportunities across your accounts
* Receive and translate client briefs, breaking these down for internal teams and reviewing work before client delivery
* Contribute to internal creative brainstorm sessions, supporting the Senior Account Director in pushing creative thinking
* Manage the full production process - from pre-production and PPMs through to shoots and edit schedules
* Manage the editorial process, briefing the team on content calendar creation and providing feedback throughout
* Review reactive social opportunities and provide appropriate creative feedback

**Influencer**

* Support the influencer team with talent management and fee negotiation
* Approve influencers and influencer content from a client and brand perspective, considering reputation, fit and objectives
* Review contracts and briefs for all influencer activity across your accounts

**Internal & Management**

* First line of support for executives - 1:1s, day-to-day guidance, workload management and mentorship
* Lead internal status calls and act as the main point of contact for internal queries on your accounts
* Manage invoicing across campaigns, including raising POs and scheduling payments with the accounts team

**What we are looking for**

*Whilst we appreciate, you’re not just your CV and skills are transferable, these are some of the skills and experiences we think would set you up for success in this role:*

* Proven experience in an account management role within a social or creative agency
* Strong client-facing skills - confident presenting, leading calls and building relationships
* Excellent project management ability - detail-oriented, deadline-driven and able to juggle multiple accounts
* Comfortable managing budgets and tracking delivery against scope
* Deeply plugged into social culture, trends and platforms
* A natural collaborator who can brief, manage and support internal teams
* Experience managing or mentoring junior team member

**A Coolr Offer**

*We appreciate all the hard work that our teams deliver every day — here are some of the benefits and perks you’ll enjoy while working at Coolr:*

Competitive salary reflective of your experience and aligned with our internal salary bands.

‍️Flexible Hybrid working. We work 3 days in the office and 2 from home

Enjoy 20 days of paid time off (PTO), in addition to all U.S. Federal Holidays.

Birthday Day off – an extra day to celebrate your big day

Wellbeing day off — one additional day off plus a $50 voucher to support your wellbeing.

Private Healthcare cover, Tech scheme + more

Coolr weekly socials - we get together every week to connect as a team

A competitive, benchmarked salary ranging from $85,000-100k, based on your experience and level.

**Coolr Culture:**

We are one team. Regardless of what you work on at the agency, we will help and support each other on everything. The goal is to turn our clients into rockstars by creating ground-breaking, award-winning and impactful campaigns for them. The team culture is to push out of our comfort zones to strive for excellence whilst allowing everyone to embrace their true selves and tap into their potential.

**Coolr DE&I**

Our approach to DE&I at Coolr is simple: create a safe and inclusive environment for people to be authentically themselves. By embracing this culture, it gives space to people to be more creative, innovative, and successful which will drive us in our mission of becoming the world’s best social media agency. Whilst we are proud of our current position and the work we do to support a thriving and diverse workplace, we always know we can do more to not only create change here at Coolr, but in our industry as a whole.

jobs.description:
### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

* Continue experience in sales or clinical setting.
* Promote and sell Stryker Emergency Care Hospital products to meet our customers’ needs.
* Achieve your assigned quota by taking a consultative approach to Hospital sales, marketing, and clinical demonstrations of all related products and programs.
* Become the resident the resident Hospital/Patient Resuscitation and Treatment (PRT) expert as you work with nurses, medical directors, and administrators. Your knowledge not only of your own products, but of competitors’ offerings, builds credibility with your customers.

**What you need**

**Required:**

* High school diploma and 5+ years of professional experience.

**Preferred:**

* Bachelor’s Degree.

Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD&D insurance, and short-term disability insurance. jobs.description:
**Salon Customer Experience Specialist**

The Customer Sales and Experience Specialist is the first and last impression of the salon, responsible for creating a welcoming, professional, and elevated experience for every guest. This role ensures smooth front desk operations, accurate appointment scheduling, and prompt, courteous service. In addition to supporting the salon team and resolving client concerns, the Customer Sales and Experience Specialist plays a key role in driving salon success by confidently recommending and selling retail products that support each guest's hair routine. By combining exceptional customer service with product knowledge and sales focus, this role helps build client trust, boost revenue and reinforces the salon's commitment to delivering expert care beyond the chair.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Sales**

* Proactively recommends retail products based on guests' needs, stylist consultation and seasonal promotions.
* Achieves or exceeds individual retail sales goals and contribute to overall salon sales targets.
* Educates guests on the benefits and usage of products to support their at-home care routine.
* Partners with stylists to reinforce product recommendations during checkout.
* Supports the execution of in-salon promotions, product launches and limited time offers.
* Actively supports daily, weekly, and monthly retail goals by educating guests and upselling salon products which need to also result in meeting the minimum productivity expectations for the CSES position.
* Drives retail sales by recommending products that align with guest needs and stylist consultation while utilizing FindMore when appropriate.
* Encourages guest rebooking and promotes JCPenney Rewards and Credit Card acquisition and usage.

**Customer Service**

* Greets every guest with warmth and professionalism, creating a welcoming and memorable first impression.
* Engages and actively listens; ensures guests feel supported, and excited to return.
* Delivers a seamless and personalized experience throughout the guest's visit, ensuring satisfaction from check-in to check-out.
* Communicates effectively with guests to confirm appointments and answer questions.
* Supports a positive team environment by collaborating with stylists, managers, and fellow Customer Experience Specialists.
* Upholds a high standard of hospitality that reflects the salon's commitment to quality in every detail.

**General Operations**

* Meets or exceeds company attendance and on-time standards.
* Participates in ongoing skills development through company and/or vendor provided training and skill practice.
* Promotes and supports events that drive traffic, client engagement, and service bookings.
* Participates in team meetings and training to stay aligned with salon goals.
* Ensures front desk operations run smoothly, including accurate scheduling, guest check in and out and payment processing.
* Upholds salon cleanliness and organization standards within front desk and salon retail area.
* Handles phone and in person inquiries with efficiency and professionalism.
* Supports inventory management by tracking product levels, restocking retail shelves and alerting leadership of low stock.
* Follows salon policies and procedures, including safety, sanitation, and compliance protocols.

**Qualifications:**

* **Passion for Salon**: A love for product and salon services. An understanding of the client's benefits from products and a variety of salon services.
* **Results:** Solve problems and make smart decisions that drive sales, profit, and customer service; execute work efficiently and effectively; inspire strong performance in yourself and others.

* **Intensity:** Proactively find ways to improve the customer experience; show the confidence and courage to do what is right; act with energy and urgency.

**What you get:**

If eligible, we offer a competitive benefits package including medical/dental/vision, term life insurance, paid vacation/holidays\*, and 401(k) with Company match. All associates are eligible for an associate discount on JCPenney merchandise. For paid holidays, associates who are eligible for paid vacation (MTO) are also eligible for eight paid holidays during the calendar year. All store hourly associates scheduled to work on a designated holiday will receive additional compensation. \*For paid vacation days, as well as eligibility requirements for other benefits, please visit www.catalystbrandsbenefits.com

**About JCPenney:**

JCPenney is the shopping destination for diverse, working American families. With inclusivity at its core, the Company's product assortment meets customers' everyday needs and helps them commemorate every special occasion with style, quality, and value. JCPenney offers a broad portfolio of fashion, apparel, home, beauty, and jewelry from national and private brands and provides personal services including salon, portrait and optical. The Company and its 50,000 associates worldwide serve customers where, when, and how they want to shop - from jcp.com to more than 650 stores in the U.S. and Puerto Rico. In 2024, JCPenney celebrates 122 years as an iconic American brand by continuing its legacy of connecting with customers through shopping and community engagement.

jobs.description:
**Vintage Sales & Operations Coordinator**

LA Vintage | Full-time | On-site | Los Angeles, CA 90061

$22–$24/hr + monthly performance bonus

**About Us**

LA Vintage is a family-owned wholesale vintage company in Los Angeles. We sort millions of pounds of clothing, shoes, and accessories every year, and since 2008 we've supplied retail shops, designers, wholesalers, and stylists around the world straight from our own warehouse.

**The Role**

We're looking for an organized person to run day-to-day sales operations at LA Vintage. You'll pack and ship wholesale and online orders, price and list inventory, and keep the showroom clean and shoppable. You'll also watch sales trends, spot what's moving and what's stuck, and bring us ideas to sell more online. You know your vintage eras and brands, you're comfortable with spreadsheets, and you take pride in getting the details right.

**What You'll Do Daily**

* Pack and ship online orders accurately and on time
* Pull, price, and pack in-person and remote client orders, checking each one against its invoice
* Handle in-person checkouts and invoicing
* Price, photograph, and list pieces online
* Keep the showroom stocked, organized, and reset before appointments
* Respond to client emails, calls, and texts the same business day
* Log all orders, sales, and listings in our trackers

**What You'll Do Weekly**

* Report on orders completed, sales, listings added, and open orders
* Review sales data to review what's selling, what's sitting, and why
* Recommend one change to improve online sales (pricing, categories, listing timing, promotions)
* Flag aging inventory and recommend price adjustments
* Follow up with past clients to drive reorders

**How Success Is Measured**

* Order accuracy: orders ship complete, correct, and on time
* Sales: monthly online and client order sales against target

**What You Bring**

* 1+ years of experience with buying, selling, or pricing vintage clothing, with solid knowledge of eras and brands
* Builds routines and sticks to them
* Comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets, and tracking results
* Detail-oriented: you catch mistakes before clients do
* Clear, professional communication in writing and in person
* Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced warehouse
* Shopify, Excel, or Google Sheets experience is a plus
* Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus

**Pay & Benefits**

* $22–$24/hr, depending on experience
* Monthly performance bonus based on order accuracy and sales (eligible after 3 months)
* Employee health insurance after 3 months
* Access to wholesale clothing

**How to Apply**

Email a 1–2 minute video to info@lavintage.com telling us:

* Why you want this role
* How you stay organized
* Your favorite decade in fashion, and why

Pay: $22.00 - $24.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Experience:

* buying, selling, or pricing vintage clothing: 1 year (Required)

* Los Angeles, CA 90061 (Required)

jobs.title: Sales Representative, Architecture & Design
jobs.description:
About MICRO:

MICRO is a premium architectural finishes company specializing in microcement systems. We supply and install decorative finishes for residential, commercial, and hospitality projects across North America. We control everything from product supply to certified installation, so quality and accountability stay consistent on every project. We train our certified installers in-house, and are available on Material Bank.

The role:  
We're looking for a motivated, design-savvy Sales Representative who loves building real relationships with the architecture and design community. You'll grow and manage a portfolio of accounts in your territory, open new business, and work closely with our Sales Manager to expand MICRO's presence in the market.

This isn't a transactional sales job. Our process is consultative: you'll work with designers and architects over weeks or months to get MICRO specified on projects, then support the client through installation and completion.

What you'll do:  
- Find and develop new business in your assigned territory  
- Build strong relationships with architects, interior designers, general contractors, and developers  
- Present MICRO's products, capabilities, and installation process to clients and specifiers  
- Get MICRO specified in project documents at the design development stage  
- Manage an active pipeline from first contact to signed contract  
- Run site visits, client meetings, and showroom presentations  
- Deliver and follow up on sample requests promptly  
- Attend industry events, trade shows, and networking functions  
- Keep accurate, up-to-date records in HubSpot CRM  
- Work with the Sales Manager and operations team to make project delivery seamless  
- Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets

What we're looking for:  
- 2 to 5 years of sales experience, ideally in architecture, interior design, construction, or luxury materials  
- Existing relationships in the design and build community (a strong plus)  
- Specification or consultative selling experience (preferred)  
- Familiarity with construction, building materials, or decorative finishes

**Step into the Night Shift at LAX**
------------------------------------

It’s 9:00 p.m. in Los Angeles, CA. You’ve just checked the inbound roster, aligned the cargo load plan, and radioed the ramp team. Minutes later, an unexpected hold appears—space confirmation needs to be revalidated and a cargo compartment must be cleared. You move quickly, coordinating with ground handling agents (AGI), confirming documentation, and keeping the flight on schedule. By 7:00 a.m., every shipment is accounted for, safety standards are met, and customers are updated—another smooth overnight operation.

**What You’ll Lead**
--------------------

* Coordinate end-to-end cargo operations while upholding safety and regulatory compliance.
* Plan, schedule, and track shipments; optimize routings to minimize delays.
* Partner with internal teams and external vendors to quickly resolve operational issues.
* Prepare, verify, and archive precise cargo documentation for all movements.
* Monitor inventory and support stock replenishment to meet service timelines.
* Audit processes regularly to identify improvements and boost efficiency.
* Deliver responsive customer service, addressing inquiries and concerns promptly.

**On the Ramp**
---------------

* Oversee ground handling agents (AGI), ensuring procedures are followed and status updates are timely.
* Verify strict adherence to cargo handling procedures, including space confirmation and cargo compartments clearance.
* Coordinate with agents to resolve unexpected on-site disruptions.
* Supervise aircraft loading and unloading activities for accuracy and safety.
* Monitor ramp operations to enable safe, on-time aircraft turns.

**Flight Documentation & Control**
----------------------------------

* Build cargo load plans using manual or computerized systems.
* Complete aircraft weight-and-balance documentation accurately.
* Coordinate with dispatchers and maintenance for inbound and outbound flights.
* Review all cargo paperwork for completeness and correctness.

**Communication & Support**
---------------------------

* Maintain clear communication with internal teams, vendors, and partner agencies.
* Champion operational efficiency, service quality, and cost control.
* Perform additional duties as assigned during the shift.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* High school diploma or equivalent; degree in logistics, supply chain, or related field is a plus.
* Hands-on experience in cargo operations or logistics management.
* Knowledge of shipping regulations and compliance practices.
* Exceptional organization and multitasking skills.
* Proficiency with logistics software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Clear, effective verbal and written communication.
* Comfort working independently and within a team in a high-velocity environment.

------------------

* Cargo Operations

**1. ABOUT Company:**

Company was founded to meet a growing need: a better way to design and build. The practice is based in the San Francisco Bay Area and provides architecture, interiors, design build, construction management, landscape, advisory, and development services. One multidisciplinary team of architects, designers, builders, managers, and strategists carries each project from idea to built work.

The firm is advancing a more integrated model of design build delivery, in which the people who design a project stay with it through construction, so that design intent carries from the first drawing to the finished building without a handoff.

The firm takes on residences, restaurants, hospitality, adaptive reuse, and multifamily projects, from ground up buildings to tenant improvements and small projects. Construction is performed by General Contractors, a licensed builder with its own build team and its own millwork.

**2. ROLE:**

The Designer and Project Coordinator is a design professional who supports project delivery across design and construction phases within the firm's architect led design build team. With a foundation in architectural training and a curiosity for building processes, this individual leads the firm's Revit modeling and visualization work and plays a key role in project documentation, consultant coordination, and jobsite integration.

The role offers exposure to all phases of project development, with mentorship from experienced Project Leads and the goal of leading a small project within the first year. It is an opportunity for someone who values organization, craft, and progressive design solutions and is interested in a fast paced, collaborative environment. Approximately 65 percent of the role is design and documentation, and 35 percent is project coordination and construction support.

**3. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Design and documentation**

* Develop design drawings, permit sets, and construction documents.
* Lead BIM development in Revit, and maintain the firm's Revit templates and standards.
* Develop and manage 3D digital models in Rhino under direction of the Project Lead.
* Create and manage presentation materials, including diagrams, models, and renderings.
* Contribute to drawing coordination with consultants and the internal team.
* Measure and document existing conditions in the field.

**Project coordination**

* Maintain and update project files, schedules, and design documentation.
* Track consultant deliverables, permit submittals, and project milestones.
* Participate in internal design reviews, client meetings, and consultant coordination calls.
* Support material research, specification development, and procurement tracking.
* Assemble bid packages and track subcontractor responses.

**Construction support**

* Attend job site visits and assist with field documentation, including photos, notes, and punch lists.
* Help manage RFIs, submittals, and construction correspondence.
* Translate field feedback into design updates and revisions.
* Collaborate with trades and site staff under supervision of the Project Lead.

**4. QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in architecture.
* Minimum of five years of professional experience in architecture or construction.
* Advanced proficiency in Revit, and working knowledge of Rhino.
* Proficiency in rendering tools such as V-Ray and Enscape, and familiarity with Adobe CreativeSuite.
* Interest in both design and building processes, with a desire to grow across disciplines.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and follow direction.

* Growth mentality: You are eager to learn, ask questions, receive feedback, and expand your skills.
* Integrity: You show up, follow through, and hold yourself accountable every day. You take pride in your work and look for ways to improve it.
* Self starter: You take initiative and look for ways to improve or contribute.
* Team mentality: You support others and ask for help when needed. You recognize that no task is too small, and you go above and beyond to help others.
* Curiosity for design build: You want to understand how drawings become buildings and how building informs drawings.

**Ecology Center Background:**

The Ecology Center's mission is to inspire and build a sustainable, healthy, and just future for the East Bay, California, and beyond. Since 1970, we've transformed sustainability ideas into everyday practice, offering actionable information, reliable infrastructure, and leadership for lasting change. We operate the nation's first curbside recycling service, nationally recognized food and farming programs, and model education, engagement, and youth development activities.

**Role Overview:**

The Farmers' Market Access and Equity Program Coordinator works under the direction of the Farmers' Market AccessEquity Program Manager, in coordination with the Food and Farming Program Director, to assist with all aspects relating to the Ecology Center's work promoting healthy food access at California farmers' markets. The Farmers' Markets Access and Equity Program Coordinator works to establish, implement, promote, and incentivize Federal Assistance Benefit use at farmers' markets and other direct marketing outlets to create greater healthy food choices for low-income and underserved populations and drive additional customers/income to small and mid-sized family farmers.

The Ecology Center is actively working to create and promote an alternative food system that is based on the values of environmental protection, justice, and access to healthy, sustainably produced food for all. The Farmers' Markets AccessEquity Program (FMAE) seeks to create greater healthy food choices for low-income and underserved Californians while also supporting small and mid-sized family farms. The FMAE Program Coordinator works to establish, implement, promote, and incentivize SNAP benefit use at farmers' markets and other direct marketing outlets. The FMAE Program Coordinator performs job duties in support of the Ecology Center's work supporting healthy food access at California farmers' markets, including the Market Match Program, Farmers' Market EBT/SNAP access programming , and the FMFinder.org tool. This is a hybrid position that requires employees to work onsite at least 2 days per week. The position is covered under the Ecology Center/IWW Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), and employees are required to maintain union membership once they complete their probation period.

* Assist Program Manager in developing Program work-plan, goals, and objectives in accordance with grant objectives and the Ecology Center mission and strategic plan.

* Assist with facilitating bi-monthly webinars, phone calls, the annual Market Match conference, and other meetings.
* Educate, recruit, and inform farmers' market managers, associations, and partner organizations interested in CalFresh EBT access at farmers' markets and Market Match incentives, through the development and distribution of Program communications, including informational materials and e-newsletters.
* Periodically coordinate regional outreach campaign logistics including direct mailers, text message, and other forms of outreach, aimed at recruiting new customers to farmers' markets.
* Perform site-visits with Market Match partners throughout the state to ensure program and grant compliance.
* Input and maintain data in order to feed statewide databases, fundraise, and report for grants.
* Customize promotional, outreach, and educational collateral.
* Provide technical assistance to farmers' market managers and associations that wish to establish, implement, and promote their market's CalFresh EBT program. This includes, but is not limited to: assistance with FNS application, acquiring Point Of Sale (POS) equipment, EBT scrip design and ordering, planning for market staffing issues, record-keeping and vendor education.
* Conduct follow up activities to track and report progress in establishing and implementing EBT programs.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, Healthcare
jobs.description:
Sunnyvale, CA

**OLOID · Sunnyvale, CA · Full time**

Hospitals run on shared workstations and badge taps, and every tap is a login. That is the problem OLOID solves, and it is why health systems are the natural next market after its Fortune 500 manufacturing and retail customers. This seat owns top of funnel for that patch, sitting alongside a dedicated healthcare enterprise seller.

**How we sell**
---------------

We have built a modern selling motion and you will have the tech stack you would expect. You open the organisational conversations it runs on, multi threading across clinical, security, IT and executive buyers, and every meeting you book is qualified to MEDDPICC standards. You are the designated BDR for an enterprise seller and work as a true partner with them and with pre sales, and the wins are shared across the team.

**Why now**
-----------

2027 is a big year. Revenue is up 600 percent since the Series A and we are going after seven figure enterprise deals. Microsoft retires SMS and voice MFA in Entra ID in February 2027, which pushes every enterprise toward exactly what we sell. Healthcare is the next big market, and Aura, our AI identity assurance agent, is already part of Workday’s Agent System of Record.

**A lean team with real ownership**
-----------------------------------

This is a lean commercial team reporting into our core executive team. You own your patch and your number end to end, with real influence over how we sell and who joins next.

**Is this you?**
----------------

It is not for the faint hearted. You will wear many hats, build pipeline without a big machine behind you, and make calls without a playbook. If you have sold in a high growth environment and bring a growth mindset, you will thrive here, at a genuinely exciting moment for the company.

**Why OLOID**
-------------

OLOID builds passwordless identity for frontline workers and shared devices: the nurse, the line worker, the store associate who moves between shared workstations all shift, often with no work smartphone. They sign in with a face, a badge tap or NFC, layered onto Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity and the systems a company already runs. Tyson Foods, PepsiCo, GE, Takeda, Flex and Honeywell are customers, and we are backed by Dell Technologies Capital, Okta Ventures and Honeywell Ventures.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Own top of funnel for healthcare: roughly 60 percent cold outbound, 40 percent warm leads and inbound
* Build target lists of the people worth reaching inside health systems, and multi thread rather than firing at one contact
* Run outreach across calling, email and social, and qualify inbound from events and campaigns
* Book meetings and demos, brief the account executive properly, and work as their partner through the deal
* Mine the CRM for new needs in prospects already there

**What you bring**
------------------

* 1 to 3 years in lead generation, sales or marketing, with at least 12 months of real outbound
* A genuine understanding of how US health systems buy and who signs
* A methodical, research first approach. Twenty researched messages beat two hundred sprayed ones
* Based in the Bay Area, or ready to relocate
* Resilience. There are a lot of no answers, and patience matters more than polish

**Great if you also have**
--------------------------

A bachelor’s degree is preferred, not required. People who do this well move into product, pre sales and customer facing roles, and OLOID will build toward that deliberately.

**Where you work**
------------------

Full time in our Sunnyvale office. You must live in the San Francisco Bay Area or be prepared to relocate. We are investing in building an in person team at our Sunnyvale hub.

**Pay and the rest**
--------------------

Guideline base $80,000 to $90,000, $110,000 on target, set on experience. Medical insurance, 401k and unlimited vacation. Equity is part of every offer. You must be authorised to work in the US without employer visa sponsorship, now or in the future. OLOID is an equal opportunity employer.

**Interview stages**
--------------------

* **Intro call with our talent team.** About 30 minutes on your background, your track record and what you are looking for.

* **First interview with the hiring manager.** How you prospect, how you qualify and how you work as a true partner with your AE.

* **Pipeline walkthrough with commercial leadership.** Take us through pipeline you built: your outreach, the meetings you booked and how you qualified them.

* **Final conversation with our executive team.** Where you want to take your career, and how you would help build what comes next.

You will hear where you stand at every stage.

**Come ready**
--------------

Be confident in your past successes and ready to walk the team through them: the pipeline you built, the meetings you booked and what they turned into. We will ask for specifics, so bring them.

jobs.title: Human Resources Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Us

Homebridge serves a high risk, high needs, complex-diagnosed population with a combination of domestic, personal, and paramedical homecare functions funded through IHSS. Our work allows an often-underserved population to live safely in their community. Homebridge offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment with 350+ unionized field workers and 90+ internal office staff.

Position Summary

Homebridge is a dynamic work environment with 300+ unionized field workers and 100+ internal office staff. We serve a high-risk, high-needs population often underserved in our community. We seek a driven, personable, and organized Human Resources Operations Coordinator to join our team of dedicated staff in support of the community we serve.

Reporting to the Human Resources Supervisor, the HR Operations Coordinator oversees and plans the day-to-day operations of the HR Department and provides high-level operational and administrative support. The role manages the full pre-hire and onboarding experience for Home Care Providers (HCPs) and administrative staff, supports the Recruiting department, and owns the pre-hire and onboarding software. The Coordinator also participates in strategy and organizational projects that improve the effectiveness and efficiency of HR functions.

Success in this role comes from maintaining composure in a high-volume environment, managing varied priorities in a timely manner with great attention to detail, a strong customer service orientation, interest in advancing underserved populations, and a mature, professional attitude amid changing and sometimes challenging circumstances.

Essential Job Functions

Employee Support and Communication

* Provide exceptional customer service to employees, managers, applicants, and new hires; serve as the first line of response for inquiries about HR functions.
* Prepare and manage letters, notices, employment verifications, and other routine communications for current, former, and prospective employees and third parties.
* Prepare and manage communications for recruiting efforts internally and externally
* Respond to applicant and employee inquiries via phone, email and in person.

Recruiting and Pre-Hire

* Review new applications and move applicants through the candidate pipeline
* Coordinate and schedule phone, video, and in-person interviews between candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers.

* Conduct phone screenings and interviews, as needed
* Extend verbal offers or notify candidates who are not moving forward.
* Draft and send offer letters and new hire packets
* Maintain accurate candidate records and update applicant tracking systems (ATS)
* Support career fairs, recruiting events, and special talent acquisition projects

Onboarding

* Manage onboarding for all new hires, including facilitating new hire orientation and enhancing the employees’ introductory experience.
* Create, collect, review, and audit new hire paperwork for completeness and accuracy, including I-9 validation through E-Verify.
* Maintain the pre-hire and onboarding applicant tracking system (ATS)
* Coordinate and facilitate work readiness, leadership, career options, and other workshops that strengthen workforce skills.

HR Operations, Records, and Compliance

* Maintain internal database records and HRIS records for new hires, terminations, and other status changes
* Manage and maintain all HR records accurately and confidentially, always protecting private employee information.
* Coordinate quarterly internal audits of personnel records to confirm proper filing practices and compliance.
* Compile reports, interpret data, and support the data dashboard; provide analysis as requested.
* Assist with employee questions or concerns regarding employee relations including but not limited to HRIS system, benefits, leaves, and day to day operations
* Manage employee leaves partnering with cross functional partners
* Assist with Workers Compensations claims

* Support special projects, process improvements, ad hoc requests, and other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

* Exceptional customer service and professional communication with employees, funders, vendors, and staff at all levels, including in challenging encounters.
* Compassionate and trustworthy
* Collaborative and flexible; keeps communication open across departments.
* Stays professional under pressure, with strong time management, urgency, and independent judgment across competing priorities.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy; strict confidentiality.
* Self-starter who can work independently
* Committed to the Homebridge mission and ongoing HR learning.
* Working knowledge of HR operations and state and federal employment law.
* Experienced in Word, Outlook, Excel, and Google Docs; quickly learn ADP and the ATS.

Education and Experience

* Two to three years of administrative, high-volume staffing, or HR administration experience in a fast-paced environment, with a strong commitment to customer service.
* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Familiarity with human services and non-profits is a plus.
* Bilingual strongly preferred (Spanish or Cantonese)

Work Environment

This position is hybrid. When in the office, the role is primarily sedentary, typically involving desk work in a temperature-controlled environment within modular, individual or shared office space. Moderate walking, lifting, and material handling are also required. The noise level in the office environment is usually moderate.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individual with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit for extended periods of time at a desk or computer works

**Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future**

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

* Launches that get talked about, not just posted.

-----------

Our process includes a short case on a real problem we're working on, so you can see how we think and we can see how you do.

As an Entry-Level Sales Development Representative, you’ll identify and engage healthcare professionals through phone calls, digital outreach, and targeted sourcing. You’ll introduce candidates to career opportunities, build relationships throughout the recruiting process, research healthcare markets, and generate prospective client leads. Working alongside recruiters and account executives, you’ll manage follow-up, maintain recruiting pipelines, support negotiations, and help move searches toward successful placements.
  
  
An AI-first healthcare staffing CRM supports your work with AI-assisted sourcing, candidate matching, recruiting automation, and analytics. These tools enhance—not replace—your judgment, creativity, and ability to build trust. You’ll learn to combine technology with personalized communication while working toward clear activity and performance goals.
  
  
You’ll collaborate with experienced healthcare recruiters, account executives, recruiting leaders, and marketing professionals as you develop transferable skills in sales, business development, talent acquisition, and account management. As you demonstrate results and deepen your understanding of healthcare markets, you’ll have opportunities to take on greater responsibility and build a long-term career.
  
  
The ideal candidate is ambitious, resilient, organized, and comfortable connecting with new people by phone and through digital channels. Strong communication, consistent follow-through, curiosity, and a goal-oriented mindset are essential. You should be motivated by measurable results, receptive to feedback, and eager to learn how AI and recruiting technology can improve sourcing and engagement.
  
  
Prior healthcare recruiting experience is not required. Experience in sales, customer success, staffing, marketing, hospitality, healthcare, or another relationship-focused field can provide a strong foundation. Familiarity with nursing or hospital environments is helpful, but drive, adaptability, and a willingness to learn matter. This is an outbound sales and recruiting position designed for someone pursuing a long-term sales career—not an administrative HR role or a patient-care assignment.
  
  
Based in downtown San Francisco, you’ll build your career in a city known for technology, entrepreneurship, and innovation. The location offers access to a broad professional network, public transportation, diverse neighborhoods, dining, and cultural attractions, with Northern California’s outdoor destinations within reach.
  
  
Clinical Management Consultants offers competitive base compensation, uncapped commissions, bonus opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan. If you’re ready to bring ambition, curiosity, and competitive drive to healthcare sales and recruiting, contact the Clinical Management Consultants recruiting team to learn more about this Entry-Level Sales Development Representative opportunity.

The Communications Assistant supports the Development and Communications Department in executing the organization’s communications, marketing, storytelling, digital engagement, and public relations activities in support of SVdP–Alameda County’s mission and strategic goals.

The Communications Assistant provides hands-on support with content creation, graphic design, short-form video, social media, website management, newsletters, donor communications, marketing materials, and event communications. jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Tenant Success Services
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US:** - We believe that everyone deserves a home!
  
  
Breaking Ground operates nearly 4,000 units of housing across New York City, along with housing in upstate New York and Connecticut. Supportive housing - affordable housing paired with services designed to help people maintain their homes for the long-term - is widely recognized as a proven and cost-effective solution to chronic homelessness.
  
  
But we didn't stop at providing housing. Breaking Ground's programs and services help people experiencing street homelessness - especially those who have been on the streets the longest - to come indoors. Through our Street to Home outreach program and transitional housing resources, we help people get, and stay, on the path to a permanent home.
  
  
Reporting to the Assistant Program Director, Tenant Success Services, the Program Coordinator, Tenant Success Services provides supervisory oversight to a new and growing team of Housing Retention Specialists using a Critical Time Intervention (CTI)-informed model; providing time-limited services focused on housing retention, resource development, and community integration with the goal of helping formerly homeless individuals and families prevent eviction and return to shelter.
  
These services are provided to individuals and families exiting the shelter system and moving into apartments in new developments located in Brooklyn, Queens, and Manhattan. The Program Coordinator collaborates with Tenant Services Coordinators who provide ongoing community support to these individuals and families following the first year of tenancy. The Program Coordinator is responsible for ensuring that service provision is of the highest quality and is consistent with CTI-informed principles.
  
Depending on program need, this position may carry a small caseload of more complex clients. The Program Coordinator liaises with community stakeholders, funders, property management, and real estate development companies, and serves as a member of the Light Touch Services’ management team.
  
This position has a 35-hour work week.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Provide direction and leadership to the program; help troubleshoot, problem solve, and strategize solutions around client engagement and challenging behaviors
* Manage caseload assignments and conduct case reviews with staff
* Provide training to staff on Critical Time Intervention model
* Oversee development and implementation of individual service plans; ensure documentation of client contact and progress is comprehensive and timely
* Assess and evaluate client functioning
* Supervise and conduct case conferences
* Coordinate delivery of care with multiple service providers
* Work collaboratively with property management teams as needed to ensure clients succeed in housing and avoid return to homelessness
* Provide support and guidance to front line staff in managing difficult situations and successfully de-escalating conflict
* Produce timely outcomes reports based on services provided as well as track program participants' entry and exit and monitor for accuracy
* Perform other duties as assigned

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**  

* LMSW preferred; extensive experience working with the target population may be substituted for a master’s degree
* Minimum 3 years of experience working with homeless, mentally ill, undocumented, and/or substance using populations
* Housing-based case management experience strongly preferred
* Previous supervisory experience and strong clinical and assessment skills preferred
* Preferred training in CPR and First Aid, Opioid Overdose Prevention, crisis intervention, de-escalation
* Familiarity with Critical Time Intervention principles preferred
* Proficiency in motivational interviewing techniques preferred
* Superb collaborative skills; Ability to work successfully with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders
* Creativity, strong problem-solving ability
* Ability to delegate and motivate both staff and clients
* Ability to communicate (verbally and written) with diverse populations and stakeholders
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite programs including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Microsoft Teams; proficiency with property management and case management software
* Ability to travel throughout the 5 boroughs via public transportation or vehicle
* Valid NY, NJ, CT, or PA driver’s license with a good driving record, as defined by Breaking Ground is preferred
* Bilingual preferred

EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled

jobs.description:
Salary: $65,000

Reports To: Assistant Director, Career Exploration & Readiness Continuum

Hours: Monday through Friday, 35 hours per week, including some evening hours to support Hub programming; occasional weekend hours as needed.

About The Door

The Door has served as one of New York City’s most trusted places for teens and young adults for more than 50 years. The Door’s mission is to empower young people to reach their potential by providing comprehensive youth development services in a diverse and caring environment.

A nationally recognized model for holistic youth support, The Door reaches up to 10,000 young people annually through a wide range of free, co-located services. Youth ages 12 to 24 can access health care and health education, mental health counseling and crisis intervention, legal services, career and education programming, housing supports, services for runaway and homeless youth, arts and recreational programming, and nutritious daily meals, all under one roof. The majority of youth served are navigating systemic barriers, including disconnection from school or work, housing instability, and involvement in foster care or the justice system.

Within this model, The Door operates a robust Career and Education Services Department (CareerED), including general work-readiness training and 14 sector-based workforce programs aligned with high-demand industries such as construction, green jobs, healthcare, information technology, retail, culinary arts, theater production, and commercial driving. These programs combine technical training, industry-recognized credentials, paid internships, and job placement support, in partnership with institutions such as CUNY and leading employers.

About the Youth Exploration & Career Navigation Hub

In Fall 2026, The Door will launch NYC’s first Youth Exploration & Career Navigation Hub (the Hub). The Hub addresses a longstanding citywide gap: while NYC has invested heavily in education, workforce, and youth services, the broader system remains fragmented, difficult to navigate, and not designed around how young people explore options, make decisions, and move forward over time.

The Hub is a welcoming, youth-centered space where young people can walk in, get paired with a dedicated Citywide Career Navigator, explore their interests and goals, and receive warm connections to best-fit education, training, and employment opportunities across NYC.

Onsite, the Hub also offers a Career Exploration & Readiness Continuum consisting of four immediate-entry and stackable pathways: immersive Virtual Reality career exploration with Transfr; a Career Readiness Certificate workshop series; the six-week Transfr Trek cohort; and the seven-week Mesa Alumni Lab cohort. The Continuum is designed so that young people can begin exploring and building momentum immediately rather than waiting for the next program or cohort to begin.

A defining feature of the Hub is its commitment to ongoing support and returnability. Young people are never rejected, never exited simply because a pathway did not work out, and are always welcomed back without stigma. The Hub operates on a “No Eject, No Reject” philosophy.

Position Overview

The Intake & Operations Coordinator will serve as one of the first welcoming faces young people encounter when entering the Hub and will play a critical role in making sure every young person is quickly connected to a meaningful next step.

After a young person completes The Door’s membership intake, or when an existing Door member comes to the Hub seeking career or education support, the coordinator will welcome them, understand what they are looking for, and help connect them to the appropriate Hub staff member or program. Depending on the young person’s needs and availability, this may include a Citywide Career Navigator, Employment Specialist, one of the Career Exploration & Readiness Continuum pathways, or an immediate Transfr VR career exploration experience while they wait for another service to become available.

The coordinator will also manage critical day-to-day Hub operations, including participant flow, waitlists, scheduling, cohort enrollment coordination, Transfr headset management, and basic program tracking. When appropriate, the coordinator will help young people begin exploring careers through Transfr VR so that no young person enters the Hub and is left without something meaningful to engage in.

This role requires someone who is exceptionally organized and responsible while also being warm, approachable, flexible, and highly skilled at engaging young adults. The ideal candidate believes that the way a young person is greeted and supported in their first few minutes can shape their willingness to trust the Hub and come back.

Why This Role Matters

The Hub is designed around a simple principle: a young person should be able to walk in, engage immediately, and begin moving forward on their journey that day. The Hub will be the first place in New York City where young people can walk in and immediately engage in exploration/readiness programming and receive 1:1 career advising and navigation support.

That promise depends on strong coordination behind the scenes. Young people may arrive with very different needs, at different stages of readiness, and without knowing exactly what they are looking for. Navigators or Employment Specialists may be meeting with other young people, and cohort-based programs may not begin immediately.

The Intake & Operations Coordinator makes sure those realities never translate into a young person feeling ignored, confused, or turned away. This person will create a warm front door, keep the Hub organized and responsive, and help ensure that every young person leaves their initial interaction knowing what happens next.

Primary Responsibilities

Youth Welcome, Engagement & Hub Navigation

* Serve as a warm, welcoming first point of contact for young people entering the Youth Exploration & Caree
