jobs.description:
Job Title: Front Desk & Administrative Coordinator

America Works of New York | Midtown, NY

Compensation & Schedule

* Compensation: $25/hour during a short probationary period, with a $50,000 annual salary upon successful completion and approval.

* Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision.

* Schedule: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM?5:00 PM.

* Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site.

About America Works

America Works is a pioneer and recognized leader in workforce development. Its proven approach has become a model for agencies and organizations across the country looking to build effective employment programs. As a 100% woman-owned business, America Works brings a people-first perspective to everything it does.

What has remained constant throughout the organization's history is its commitment to the people it serves and the people who make its mission possible. Joining America Works means becoming part of an organization with a respected reputation, an established model for success, and a mission that makes a meaningful difference in people's lives.

Position Overview

America Works is seeking a friendly, organized, and dependable Front Desk & Administrative Coordinator to support daily office operations and assist with client engagement. This individual will serve as one of the first points of contact for clients and visitors while providing administrative support, conducting outbound client outreach, and assisting with special projects and program activities.

The position will work closely with our Ticket to Work program, which supports individuals receiving Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) benefits who are interested in exploring employment opportunities.

The ideal candidate is customer-service oriented, detail-oriented, comfortable communicating with clients over the phone, and able to balance front desk responsibilities with administrative and project-based assignments.

Key Responsibilities

* Front Desk & Reception: Greet and assist clients and visitors, answer incoming calls, direct inquiries, and maintain a welcoming and professional office environment.

* Administrative Support: Provide general administrative assistance, including scanning, filing, organizing documents, maintaining records, and supporting daily office operations.

* Client Outreach: Conduct outbound calls to clients to provide program updates, follow up on participation, share information, and encourage continued engagement.

* Office Coordination: Monitor office supply inventory, place orders, organize materials, and ensure the office remains well-stocked and organized.

* Client Assistance: Distribute MetroCard/OMNY and other approved client resources as needed and assist with client communications and general inquiries.

* Special Projects & Events: Support the coordination of office initiatives, special projects, workshops, and client events.

* Ticket to Work Program Support: Work closely with the Ticket to Work team to assist with administrative coordination, client communication, outreach, and program-related activities.

* Team Collaboration: Provide flexible administrative and operational support to management and other departments as needed.

Why Join America Works?

A place to grow your career. America Works is committed to developing its employees and helping them reach their full potential. Many team members who began in entry-level and administrative roles have advanced into management positions, site director roles, grant writing, and other leadership opportunities across the organization.

Learn from experienced professionals. Receive hands-on training and guidance from experienced workforce development professionals while learning an established model for delivering employment services and supporting clients.

Gain exposure to workforce development and social policy. Work alongside programs connected to federal workforce initiatives and gain firsthand insight into how employment programs and public policy impact individuals and communities.

Be part of a supportive team. Take ownership of your responsibilities while collaborating with experienced colleagues and management who are available to provide guidance and support.

Make a meaningful impact. Your work will directly contribute to creating a welcoming environment, keeping programs running smoothly, and ensuring clients receive the communication and support they need.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree required.

* Previous experience in reception, front desk operations, customer service, or administrative support preferred.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

* Comfortable making outbound calls and interacting with clients.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and work in a fast-paced office environment.

* Professional, approachable, and dependable demeanor.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes initiative, and is comfortable balancing administrative responsibilities with direct client interaction. The successful candidate will play an important role in keeping the office organized, supporting program operations, and ensuring clients receive timely and professional assistance.

jobs.title: Office & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Shark Byte Systems Inc. (SBS)**

Shark Byte Systems Inc. (SBS) is an innovative computer vision and artificial intelligence company headquartered in New York City. We build robust, real-time visual intelligence systems and inference models deployed to solve complex operational challenges. Our technical culture is hands-on, high-ownership, and run strictly on Linux infrastructure.

**Role Summary**

Shark Byte Systems Inc. (SBS) is looking for an organized, technically grounded, and proactive Office & Operations Coordinator to serve as the operational backbone for both our NYC office and day-to-day technical workflows.

In this multifaceted role, you will bridge day-to-day office operations with ongoing technical execution. You will work closely with our field technicians and software engineers, managing incoming support queues, directing task assignments, monitoring project milestones, purchasing hardware and project equipment, handling location-setup billing transactions, and keeping our workplace running without friction. Because we do not run rigid sprint cycles, our work centers on continuous delivery, quick triage, and clear ticket prioritization.

The ideal candidate brings familiarity with a Linux-centric engineering workplace, communicates effortlessly across technical teams, and keeps projects moving forward in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities1. Technical Task Coordination & Support Operations**

* **Task & Queue Management:** Manage ongoing technician assignments, monitor day-to-day workload capacity, and maintain clear task status visibility using Jira.
* **Support Ticket Ownership:** Act as the first line for support ticket triage; prioritize incoming issues, direct assignments to the right technical specialists, follow up on blockers, and track issues to resolution.
* **Operational Syncs & Standups:** Organize and facilitate regular status check-ins, technician handoffs, and priority reviews via Google Meet.
* **Team Communication:** Keep operational channels clear, organized, and up to date using Slack (ticket updates, incident coordination, and field tech announcements).
* **Process Improvement:** Continuously refine ticketing pipelines, intake forms, and resolution workflows to reduce turnaround times and support our technicians effectively.

**2. Project Procurement & Location Billing Operations**

* **Project Equipment Purchasing:** Source, order, and track delivery of specialized hardware, cameras, sensors, cabling, tools, and technical gear required for client deployments and technician project rollouts.
* **Payment Gateway Management:** Administer merchant gateways/payment portals to process customer credit card charges for initial location onboarding.
* **Billing Records & Expense Tracking:** Maintain accurate purchase orders, receipts, transaction records, and invoice logs reconciled with the accounting team.

**3. Office & Workplace Administration**

* **NYC Workplace Logistics:** Manage on-site office operations, desk setups, supply inventory, shipping/receiving of gear, and overall facility readiness.
* **Vendor & Facilities Liaison:** Serve as the point of contact for NYC building management, facilities personnel, maintenance, and internet/utility service providers.
* **Onboarding & Workstation Staging:** Partner with technical leads to coordinate workstation preparation (hardware procurement, seating, access passes) and schedule first-week onboarding for new team members.
* **Company Culture & Events:** Organize team lunches, tech demonstrations, client site visits, and team social events.

**Qualifications & SkillsCore Qualifications (Must-Haves)**

* **Location:** Based in the Greater New York City area with the ability to work on-site at our NYC office.
* **Relevant Experience:** 2–5 years of experience in project management, technical operations coordination, or office administration within a tech company, IT services provider, or fast-paced startup.
* **Jira & Ticket Management:** Practical hands-on experience structuring Kanban boards, managing ticket queues, writing clear issue summaries, and tracking ticket lifecycles in Jira.
* **Procurement & Financial Admin:** Experience managing purchasing/procurement pipelines for equipment and navigating credit card payment gateways/billing tools (e.g., Stripe, Authorize.net, Square, or similar merchant platforms).
* **Modern Collaboration Tools:** Proficiency with Slack (channel administration, thread organization) and Google Workspace (Google Meet, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar).
* **Communication & Multi-Tasking:** Exceptional written and verbal communication; ability to balance office logistics alongside fast-moving technical ticket queues and purchasing requests.
* **Project Methodology:** Experience with continuous flow, Kanban, or ITIL-style incident and support queue management.

**Familiarity & Nice-to-Haves**

* **Linux Familiarity:** Familiarity with or comfort working in a Linux-centric environment (including basic command-line interface literacy or shell basics, such as Ubuntu or Debian), as SBS operates on Linux systems and servers.
* **Hardware & Network Familiarity:** Prior exposure to or general familiarity with network routers, switches, and cameras is a plus.

**Benefits & Perks**

* **Competitive Compensation:** Competitive base salary, commensurate with experience.
* **Commuter Support:** Pre-tax commuter benefits (MTA / transit passes).
* **Time Off:** Paid time off (PTO) plus standard holidays.
* **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance coverage.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**At Ravenfield Productions, we handle the technical side of live events in New York City. That means stage, lighting, sound, rigging and show control for concerts, live shows and corporate stages. We are hiring an Event Coordinator to keep each production organized from the first plan through load-in, show day and strike. One team plans all our departments together, so the stage plan, the rig and the cue list are built to fit each other. In this role you will keep that plan moving. You will make sure crews, gear, venues and clients are working from the same schedule and the same drawings. What you'll do: - Build and update production schedules, crew calls and load-in and load-out timelines for each event - Advance shows with venues and clients, confirming access, dock times, power, rigging points and site rules - Send drawings, schedules, cue lists and contact sheets to our crews and to client teams, and keep track of every version - Coordinate equipment prep, rentals, trucking and deliveries with our stage, lighting, sound and rigging departments - Support our production managers on site during load-in, show and strike, and deal with changes as they come up - Track production paperwork, crew hours and post-show notes so the next event starts on a clean plan What we're looking for: - At least 1 to 2 years of experience coordinating live events, concerts, theater or corporate productions - Working knowledge of stage, lighting, sound or rigging workflows and the vocabulary that goes with them - Strong organization, clear written communication and comfort with spreadsheets and shared scheduling tools - Availability for early load-ins, evenings, weekends and overnight strikes when shows require it - A calm, practical approach when plans change close to show time If you like getting live shows to run on time and on cue, we'd like to hear from you. Send us your application and tell us about a production you helped coordinate.**

jobs.title: Special Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
Since 1891, New York's Carnegie Hall has set the international standard for excellence in performance, presenting exceptional concerts by the world’s finest artists on its three iconic stages, from orchestral concerts, chamber music, contemporary offerings, and recitals to jazz, world, and popular music. Complementing its performance activities, Carnegie Hall’s Weill Music Institute creates extensive music education and social impact programs that annually serve more than 800,000 people worldwide, playing a central role in fulfilling Carnegie Hall's commitment to making great music accessible to as many people as possible.
  
  
**Department:** Development
  
**Title of Position:** Coordinator, Special Events
  
**Reports to Position:** Director, Special Events
  
**Job Classification:** Full-time, Non-Exempt
  
  
**Scope of Responsibilities:**  
Carnegie Hall seeks an organized, detail-oriented, and service-minded Coordinator to join the Special Events team within its Development department. As the junior member of a high-functioning, five-person team, the Coordinator provides essential fundraising, administrative, and event support for Carnegie Hall's premier fundraising galas (approximately 3–4 each season) and its donor cultivation and stewardship events throughout the season.
  
Reporting to the Director of Special Events, the Coordinator will work closely with the Assistant Directors and Senior Associate to ensure that gifts are processed accurately and acknowledged promptly, that donor communications and solicitation mailings are implemented smoothly, and that the departmental calendars, materials, and financial processes run efficiently. This position is an outstanding opportunity for an emerging professional to build a strong foundation in non-profit fundraising and event management at one of the world's most celebrated cultural institutions.
  
The Coordinator is often a first point of contact for donors, patrons, and colleagues, so thoughtful, courteous, and responsive communication is essential to the role.
  
  
**Tasks & Responsibilities:**  
Gift Processing & Donor Stewardship
  

* Serve as the primary processor of gift entry for galas as assigned, recording gifts and donor information in the database and preparing timely acknowledgments and tax receipts.
* Serve as the primary contact for collecting and maintaining accurate guest names and contact information for gala attendees.
* Provide back-up gift entry support for additional galas, and draft donor confirmation emails as needed.

Solicitation & Communications Support
  

* Support gala solicitation efforts by building and segmenting mailing and invitation lists and implementing donor mailings.
* Support the creation and implementation of print and web materials, including drafting copy, conducting initial proofreading and review, and routing materials for approval.

Event Production Support
  

* Maintain the team's production calendar and a calendar of competing events, helping anticipate scheduling conflicts and key deadlines.
* Manage the complimentary guest process for galas.
* Coordinate photography and videography to document events and capture content for future use. Serve as the point person for all photography/videography projects and related donor requests.

Administrative & Financial Operations
  

* Monitor the team's general email inbox and phone hotline, responding to patron and colleague inquiries promptly and professionally.
* Process vendor invoices and reconcile a department credit card.
* Assist with post-event gala analysis to evaluate results and inform future planning.

**Skills & Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree preferred
* 1 year of internship or professional experience in fundraising, preferably in events and/or non-profit
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, understand how to prioritize workload, and be detail-oriented in a fast-paced work environment
* Computer and database skills needed, including mail merges in Microsoft Word and familiarity with Microsoft Excel. Knowledge of non-profit software a plus (such as Tessitura or Raiser's Edge)
* Some evening and weekend hours required

Even if you do not match 100% of this experience, we encourage and value diverse backgrounds and welcome anyone with a passion for this type of work to apply.
  
  
To apply please submit a COVER LETTER with your resume.
  
  
Carnegie Hall is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. Decisions concerning employment are made on the basis of an individual’s qualifications to contribute to meeting Carnegie Hall’s needs, and Carnegie Hall is committed not to discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, sex (including gender identity, gender expression or status of being transgender), sexual orientation, marital status, familial status, status as a caregiver, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses or stalking, criminal convictions (except where otherwise permitted by law), arrest record, credit history, pregnancy, age, mental or physical disability, veteran or military status, reproductive health decisions, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Business Development Coordinator - M&A

The Coordinator - Business Development works with Business Development Analysts, Managers and other marketing and business development staff and lawyers to assist with efforts to generate increased business for the Firm. The scheduled hours for this position are 9:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. The incumbent will be required to work overtime depending on the needs of the practice area lawyers and Business Development department.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Assist with submissions to league tables, directories, guides and other surveys.
* Assist with industry research used to identify potential opportunities and competitive intelligence research on legal market trends.

* Assist with certain aspects of events.
* Coordinate efforts with the Communications and Digital Marketing teams in the practice’s visibility program; on internal communications on S&C This Week, external communications on external website and social media, and to maintain practice details and lawyer bios on external website.

In addition, responsibilities related to maintaining firm and client information are to be adhered to by all employees. This includes complying with the firm’s information security policies, protecting firm assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference, and reporting security events or potential events or other security risks to management.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Excellent analytical and organizational skills, with a high level of attention to detail
* Excellent writing/editing, proofreading, grammar and research skills (a writing test is required)
* Ability to produce initial drafts that are free of typos and simple errors and ability to correct own work
* Ability to follow written and verbal instructions from senior team members or guideline documents
* Ability to handle time-sensitive requests from multiple lawyers, across time zones, and to generate quality work products in a fast-paced environment. Deadline-oriented with a clear understanding of priorities.
* Ability to work in a highly demanding environment.
* Excellent communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to reach sound conclusions and decisions independently and understanding of appropriate timing to seek guidance
* Understanding of transactional terminology and processes, as well as basic understanding of litigation terminology
* Proficiency in standard spreadsheet, database, word processing and presentation applications (e.g., Excel, Dynamics, Access, Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint are pluses), as well as with a variety of online and new media information resources. Knowledge of any CRM system is also helpful. The Firm provides additional training in core software programs, if needed.
* Excellent interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently as well as to work as a team player.

jobs.title: Customer Strategy & Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Passage Health is a fast-growing Series A startup on a mission to improve the quality and accessibility of autism care through technology. Autism diagnosis rates have surged over the past decade to 1 in 31 children, yet families still face waitlists of up to a year for care as providers—hampered by antiquated technology and manual workflows—struggle to meet surging demand.

We’re building the platform that modernizes how autism care providers work—from clinical documentation to operations to billing—transforming how care is delivered and scaling access across a $460B market.

Over the past year, Passage has grown more than 3x, driven by strong customer demand and expanding partnerships across the autism care ecosystem. As we scale, we’re focused on building durable foundations—the systems, processes, and decision-making needed to support long-term growth.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

As our Customer Strategy & Operations Specialist, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping how Passage delivers value to our largest customers. This is an opportunity to build the operating backbone of our customer function: running complex, multi-site deployments, owning the metrics that define customer success, and turning what you learn in the field into scalable playbooks and product improvements. You’ll navigate ambiguity with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Clinical teams to make every launch faster and better than the last.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Program Management:** Own implementations and rollouts for our largest customers end to end, including project plans, dependency mapping, executive business reviews, escalation paths, and the operating cadence that keeps multi-site deployments on schedule.
* **Measurable Customer Outcomes:** Own the metrics that matter, such as time-to-live for new deployments, utilization, and expansion revenue, and be accountable for moving them.
* **New Verticals & Products:** Stand up the go-to-market and operating playbook for new segments and product lines where one doesn’t exist yet, then systematize it so the next launch is faster.
* **Data-Driven Problem Solving:** Root-cause customer issues through hands-on analysis, build the reporting that surfaces where programs break, and turn findings into recommendations and workflow redesigns.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Lead deep-dive discovery on complex customer workflows and partner with Product, Engineering, and Clinical to turn what you learn into scalable product solutions.
* **Deal-to-Delivery Handoff:** Plug into late-stage deals to scope programs correctly, then own the conversion of contracted revenue into live, healthy deployments.
* **Trusted Partnership:** Act as a strategic advisor to key customer stakeholders, partnering with Support to create clear documentation and guidance that helps top-tier customers navigate complex workflows with confidence.
* **Build the Playbook:** Document what works, including implementation templates, escalation frameworks, and account operating models, so the function scales beyond you.

**What You’ll Bring**

* **Experience:** 2–6+ years in Strategy & Operations at a high-growth startup, management consulting, banking, or program management.
* **Ownership & Track Record:** A demonstrated history of owning and driving key business outcomes on high-performing teams. You’ve carried a number, a launch, or a portfolio.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Comfort digging into raw data to root-cause problems and defending recommendations with evidence. SQL or advanced spreadsheet fluency preferred.
* **Systems Thinking:** An instinct for mapping dependencies and understanding how early configuration choices shape long-term customer success.
* **Structured Program Management:** The ability to run complex, multi-stakeholder deployments that go beyond the scope of a typical CSM.
* **Startup Fit:** You roll up your sleeves, believe done is better than perfect, know which corners are safe to cut, and operate with urgency and accountability.
* **Excellent Communication:** A clear, concise communicator who makes complicated things simple, in person and in writing, up to the C-suite.
* **Curiosity:** Genuinely curious about customers, the product, and the autism care space, with a habit of asking questions and seeking better ways to work.

**Nice to have (optional):**

* Experience in healthcare technology, post-acute care, or healthcare financial services.

**Why Passage Health?**

* Outsized impact—as an early employee, your work will shape both the company and our users’ experience.
* Meaningful work using your skills to help children with autism.
* A fast-paced environment full of substantive challenges.
* Competitive salary and equity.
* Healthcare, dental, and vision benefits.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

*Passage Health is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants of every background and life experience, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.*

Compensation Range: $120K - $170K

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist**
=============================

Revin · Customer Success · Flatiron, New York City

Base: $90,000-110,000 + meaningful early equity · Full-time

Four days per week in our Flatiron office, with one remote day and flexibility when life comes up.

**About Revin**
---------------

Revin builds AI-powered software for the businesses that keep our homes running: roofing, HVAC, plumbing, remodeling, and more. We help these businesses respond to customers, book appointments, and manage the customer experience across voice, SMS, and email.

Revin handles around half a million customer conversations a month. Businesses with hundreds of millions in annual revenue rely on our products for work that directly affects their customers and their bottom line.

Our customers include Vertex Service Partners, a national roofing and exterior-services platform with over $600M in revenue, and Del-Air, a $300M+ HVAC and plumbing business. See the impact of our work: we've helped Del-Air book 11,000+ membership appointments, while ImproveIt uses Revin to set 34% of its booked appointments.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are hiring an Implementation Specialist to own every new customer onboarding at Revin, from the moment a contract is signed to the day the customer goes live.

Today, onboarding work is spread across our sales and deployment teams. You will take it over. You will pick up accounts post-sale and drive them to go-live, including executing the onboarding plan, registering new phone numbers, setting the customer up in our internal systems, and making sure our customers are set up for success from Day 1. While the FDEs build and tune AI agents for each customer, you keep the whole onboarding on schedule and make sure nothing slips. You own the path to launch: executing the playbook, the paperwork, the registrations, the prep, and the timeline. It suits someone who loves customers, organization, and is fanatical about project management. This role reports to the Strategy & Operations Manager.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Own every onboarding end to end, from signed contract to launch, as the primary point of contact for coordinating getting each customer live on time.
* Deliver a superb customer experience, from detailed execution to thoughtful and timely client communication guiding them through their first post-sale interactions with us.
* Make sure every Account Executive handoff document is complete before kickoff, and draft and execute the onboarding plan.
* Run phone number setup for each customer: manage registrations and approvals from end to end to set up the infrastructure needed to deliver our product.
* Set each new customer up in Revin's internal systems, including contract details, account records, and the onboarding tracking.
* Work with FDEs and Customer Success managers to ensure they have the information they need to successfully hold onboarding meetings and launch new customer workflows.
* Track every onboarding against its timeline and flag delays and blockers to the team early.
* As the resident onboarding expert, build on our existing systems and playbooks to turn onboarding into a scalable machine and improve it with each customer so launches get faster.

**What to Expect in the Role**
------------------------------

* You will run many onboardings at once, each with its own customer, FDE, and deadlines.
* The work is detailed and regulated. Carrier registration has strict rules, and compliance can make or break onboarding timelines and the customer experience.
* You will work with multi-location home services businesses, from family-owned operators to private equity-backed rollups. Prior home services experience is not required.
* Our onboarding process is being codified as we grow, and you will help write it.
* Work at a startup is fast-paced and business needs evolve. High performers can have the opportunity to work on adjacent projects across the business and grow with the company.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 1+ years of experience in implementation, onboarding, project management, or operations, ideally at a fast-growing B2B SaaS, AI, or tech company.
* A project management fanatic. Organized, process-oriented, and maniacal about follow-through. Every task has an owner and a date, and you chase loose ends until they close.
* Someone who cares about customers and wants them to feel taken care of from the first day.
* Comfortable with technical, rules-heavy processes. This is the nature of operating in a regulated industry and attention to detail is paramount.
* A clear writer and communicator who can explain a delay to a customer and keep a team aligned.
* A quick learner who picks up new tools fast and is comfortable using AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT in daily work.
* Excited to work in a rapidly growing startup environment surrounded by people that raise the bar every day.
* Bonus: prior startup experience or time in a highly unstructured environment.

**This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If**
-----------------------------------------

* You need a fully mature operating environment with a predefined answer for every situation.
* You do not have practice owning detailed execution. This role owns the details.
* You are uncomfortable juggling many deadlines and moving pieces at once.
* You want a safe, predictable 9-5. This role is not expected to routinely work nights and weekends, but occasional after-hours work is part of delivering excellent customer service.

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

* $90,000- 110,000 base salary
* Meaningful early equity in the company you're helping build
* Excellent health coverage. $0 employee premiums for individual medical coverage on most plans, plus dental and vision insurance
* 401(k) matching up to 4% of salary. Contribute 5% to receive the full match
* Unlimited PTO
* Commuter benefits
* Free lunches and dinners in the office
* $100/month g

jobs.title: Customer Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
Reejig is the Work Operating System for the AI powered enterprise.

We give companies a complete, validated view of their work by mapping every role, task, skill, and workflow. With this intelligence, we redesign how work should flow, surface where automation creates the highest leverage, and recommend the right AI agents for the enterprise.

Every change is measured and tied to real operational and workforce impact.

Inside Reejig, we build the same future we sell. We are developing our own AI powered workforce that supports our teams and our customers.

This is a place for builders who want to help define how work will operate in the AI era.

**The Role**

We work with some of the world's most influential leaders in AI, HR and workforce transformation.

We're looking for a Customer Marketing Associate to help our customers feel connected to Reejig — making sure their success gets celebrated, their stories get heard, and the relationship keeps growing.

You'll work closely with Marketing, Customer Success and Sales to run the campaigns and programmes that engage our customers throughout their journey with Reejig. Over time, you'll get to know our customers well — who their champions are, what they're trying to achieve, and where there's an opportunity to deepen the relationship.

And when a customer is doing something great with Reejig, you'll work with Customer Success to help find that story, capture it, and turn it into something the rest of the market can see.

This is an early career role with a lot of room to grow. We're looking for someone curious, organised and customer-obsessed who wants to learn how a customer marketing function comes together.

**What You Will Own**

**Customer Engagement**

* **Customer lifecycle campaigns.** Run thoughtful campaigns that engage customers at the moments that matter - from the moment they join Reejig through onboarding, key milestones, launches, expansions, anniversaries and renewals.
* **Customer moments.** Find ways to make our customers feel recognised and part of what we're building. Celebrate their people and the work they're pioneering.
* **Customer communications.** Make sure customers know what's happening at Reejig and have opportunities to engage with our thinking, products, events and people - without filling their inbox with generic marketing.

**Customer Intelligence**

* Work with Customer Success and Sales to understand our accounts - who's involved, what they care about, what they're trying to achieve
* Keep account maps up to date, and flag where we have gaps in relationships

**Customer Proof**

* Stay close to Customer Success to help identify outcomes, quotes and moments worth sharing
* Help turn customer conversations, results and milestones into stories, testimonials, quotes and sales evidence
* Work with Content, Social, Sales, PR and Events to help our best customer stories get seen

**Customer Advocacy**

* Help build and maintain a list of customers open to sharing their experience with Reejig
* Support opportunities for customers to have a voice — webinars, events, references, media

**What Good Looks Like at 90 Days**

* You know our customers - their priorities, champions, key stakeholders and where the strongest opportunities sit.
* Every strategic customer has a current account map showing where relationships are strong and where we need to build them.
* A clear customer marketing calendar is live across lifecycle campaigns, customer moments and communications.
* We have a visible pipeline of customer stories, proof points and advocacy opportunities.
* Our strongest customer stories are consistently being turned into proof that Marketing and Sales can use.
* Customer Success, Sales and Marketing have a simple operating rhythm for sharing customer intelligence and identifying opportunities.

**Who You Are**

* You have some experience in marketing, customer success, content, or another customer-facing role - internships count. We care more about curiosity and potential than years of experience.
* You're genuinely curious about customers - you want to understand what they're trying to achieve and what makes them excited about working with a company.
* You're a solid writer and communicator, and you're keen to get better at turning what you hear into a clear story.
* You're organised - you can keep track of details across a few accounts at once without dropping things.
* You're proactive - if you spot something worth flagging, you say something rather than waiting to be asked.
* You like working with people - customers, Customer Success, Sales - and you're comfortable asking questions to learn.
* You want to build a career in customer marketing, and you're excited to learn from a small, fast-moving team.

**Why This Matters**

Reejig is at a point of real inflection. We are building a company that will reshape how organisations operate in the AI era. The people who join now are not stepping into a role, they are stepping into a chance to build something with scale and long term impact. If you want work that changes your career and creates meaningful equity upside, this is the moment.

*The expected annual base salary for this role is $65,000–$85,000 USD, depending on experience, plus equity.*

jobs.title: Vendor Operations Associate, Accounts Payable
jobs.description:
Order.co is the System of Action for the Office of the CFO, transforming the way businesses purchase and pay into an intuitive, B2C-like shopping experience. Order.co leverages embedded AI agents and embedded financial products to reinvent the way businesses connect with their vendors.

End users enjoy a seamless, zero-training buying experience, while finance and procurement leaders gain a single platform to orchestrate how the business “should operate”. The result is an all-in-one solution that serves as a gravitational pull for spend and data, automating and eliminating procurement and finance workflows from requisition to reconciliation along the way.

Order.co is on the cutting edge of B2B Agentic Commerce, poised to be the market leader in creating a more predictive, prescriptive, and personalized experience for users.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York City, Order.co oversees nearly half a billion in annualized spend across hundreds of customers like WeWork, SoulCycle, Lume, and [solidcore]. Order.co has raised $75M in funding from industry-leading investors like MIT, Stage 2 Capital, Rally Ventures, 645 Ventures, and more. Order.co has been proudly named a 50 to Watch by Spend Matters and a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn and Inc. Magazine.

Order.co is looking for a Vendor Operations Associate, Accounts Payable to own our day-to-day accounts payable work: managing the AP inbox, paying vendor invoices accurately and on time by credit card and ACH, reconciling statements, and resolving payment issues quickly.

This is an early career role ideal for someone who enjoys problem solving, investigating issues, and working with people. You'll spend your day working through the AP inbox, processing invoice payments, reconciling vendor statements, and working with vendors and teammates to resolve discrepancies.

The role sits within our Vendor Operations organization and works closely with Accounts Payable, Fulfillment Operations, Customer Success, and our offshore operations team.

We're looking for someone who is curious, organized, accountable, and excited to learn. Prior experience in procurement, accounts payable, or vendor management is encourage but not required.

**What You'll Do**

Own and Monitor the Accounts Payable Function

* Manage the Accounts Payable inbox: triage incoming invoices, statements, and vendor inquiries, respond promptly, and escalate as needed.
* Pay vendor invoices by credit card and ACH, confirming amounts, payment details, and due dates before each payment goes out
* Reconcile invoices and vendor statements against orders and payment records
* Clarify irregular invoice items with vendors and internal teams and resolve discrepancies before payment
* Review vendor files, net terms, and payment history to ensure timely payments

Work Directly with Vendors

* Communicate with vendors to resolve order issues, payment issues, and fulfillment questions
* Help vendors understand and comply with Order.co purchasing and fulfillment processes
* Identify recurring vendor behaviors that create operational challenges and work toward long-term solutions
* Build productive relationships with vendor contacts while representing Order.co professionally

Drive Continuous Improvement

* Look for patterns and recurring issues across vendors, orders, and workflows
* Suggest improvements and automations that reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency
* Collaborate with offshore team members to ensure work is completed accurately and on time
* Contribute to process documentation and operational best practices

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong attention to detail and follow-through, especially with invoice data, payment amounts, and vendor details
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to stay organized while managing multiple priorities efficiently
* Comfortable solving problems independently and asking questions when needed
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, including formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and sorting and filtering large data sets
* Comfortable with email and business software

**Why This Role Matters**

Every day, thousands of orders flow through the Order.co platform. While many are automated, some require investigation, coordination, and problem solving to ensure successful completion.

This role serves as a critical bridge between customers, vendors, and internal teams, helping ensure vendors are paid accurately and on time, orders are fulfilled, vendors remain compliant with our processes, and operational issues are resolved before they impact the customer experience.

It's an opportunity to develop valuable skills in accounts payable, operations, vendor management, procurement, and process improvement while making an immediate impact on the business.

**What You'll Receive**
-----------------------

* A competitive compensation package including stock options
* Employer-sponsored 401(k) with employer match
* Robust medical, dental, vision, and wellness benefits
* Flexible time off and remote work policies
* Generous leave policies and support for new and current parents
* The anticipated hourly rate for this role is $25-$27/hour. Actual compensation and title will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skills.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

**Who Are We Looking For?**

At Vestwell, we know that the key to growth is a high-performing sales team. That's why we're seeking a qualified Sales Development Representative (SDR) to find and screen potential customers who could benefit from our range of financial wellness products and services. As the first line of communication with a prospect, the ideal SDR has a strong understanding of the sales methodology and excels at:

* Engaging new clients through high volume calls and call cadences
* Driving qualification, urgency and intent
* Creating effective sales meetings for sales closers that optimize prospect conversion

Vestwell SDRs should be a quick learner who has strong communication skills and an ability to showcase our offerings in a compelling way. SDRs are generally in this role between 6-9 months. After month 9, successful SDRs are eligible for promotion into full cycle, closing roles.

**What Will You Be Doing?**

* Represent the company's products and services & deliver Vestwell's value proposition to new prospects, including both financial advisors and business owners.
* Qualify prospects, build intent & generate new meetings for sales through outbound calling.
* Manage and maintain a pipeline of interested prospects and engage sales leaders in next steps.
* Own your personal growth and development as a Vestwell sales representative by learning the financial services industry, Vestwell's range of financial wellness solutions, and the mechanics of a modern sales process.
* Ability to utilize Salesforce & Salesloft to manage lead lists.
* Understanding the Vestwell partnerships.
* Understanding the products and services Vestwell offers.
* Master talk tracks and ability to qualify prospects.
  + Identify the needs of prospects, and suggest appropriate products or services.
* Set up meetings for prospects with field sales representatives.
* Report to sales manager with weekly, monthly, and quarterly results.

**Requirements**

The Necessities

* Strong communication skills via phone and email.
* Proven, creative problem-solving approach and strong analytical skills.
* Displays self-motivation for sales coaching and development.
* Strong desire and ability to move up within a sales organization.

The Extras

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) or at least five years of relevant work experience.
* Previous experience in sales, with a track record of exceeding lead targets.
* Experience as a sales development representative, with a track record of achieving & exceeding sales quotas.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Salesloft, or other CRM software.
* Financial services &/or small business sales experience.

This role will be based in our Austin or New York office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation.

The expected base salary range for this position is a minimum of $55K - $60K, plus performance based variable. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**  
We're an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan.

**Interview Process**  
Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises.

Ann Taylor embodies and celebrates the spirit, heritage, and confidence of American women leading the lives they love. Since its beginnings, Ann Taylor has been committed to providing women with everything they need to feel inspired and motivated as they navigate their multifaceted lives. jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant to the Owner, AI & Merchandising**

**\*\*\*Onsite work is required four days a week.\*\*\***

We are looking for an Executive Assistant with a strong, working understanding of AI to serve as the Owner's right hand and trusted lieutenant. The Owner leads merchandising, design, sourcing, production, and sales. This role keeps the business running smoothly around him and joins him in every business meeting.

This is not a traditional calendar-and-inbox role. The Owner is highly knowledgeable about AI and uses it daily on his phone, but does not work on a computer, email or desktop software such as Windows and Excel. The Executive Assistant will be his partner in bringing AI tools and processes into the company: turning his ideas into working computer-based workflows, handling the desktop and email side of the business, and helping the team adopt AI.

The ideal candidate also brings a flair for marketing and merchandising: an eye for product, trends and brand presentation, and a genuine interest in what makes customers buy.

**Key Responsibilities**

***AI Enablement (Top Priority)***

* Use AI tools daily to draft correspondence, summarize documents, prepare meeting notes, research vendors and markets, and organize information for the Owner.
* Work closely with the Owner on his AI vision, translating ideas he develops on his phone into tools, documents, and workflows the team uses on their computers.
* Identify everyday tasks across merchandising, design, sourcing, production, and sales where AI can save time or improve results.
* Help pilot, document and roll out new AI tools and workflows with department teams, including simple how-to guides and training.
* Follow company guidelines on confidentiality and data privacy when using AI tools and flag risks to the Owner.
* Stay current on new AI tools.

***Marketing and Merchandising Support***

* Support the Owner on merchandising decisions, including line reviews, assortment planning, pricing discussions, and sell-through tracking.
* Prepare polished product presentations, line sheets and showroom materials for buyers and customers.
* Help create marketing content such as product descriptions, social media posts, email campaigns, and sales presentations, using AI tools to draft and refine them.
* Research trends, competitors, and customer preferences, and share insights that inform design and product decisions.
* Use AI to analyze sales data and identify best sellers, slow movers, and new opportunities.
* Coordinate with design, production and sales teams on product launches, samples, and market events.

***Executive and Administrative Support***

* Manage the Owner's email, calendar, travel, and correspondence on his behalf, since he does not use email or a computer, and function as his first point of contact.
* Prepare reports, spreadsheets, presentations and briefing materials, turning information from different departments into clear summaries he can review easily on his phone.
* Handle confidential business information with discretion.

***Meetings***

* Attend all business meetings with the Owner, including internal, vendor, factory, and customer meetings.
* Prepare agendas and background materials, take notes, and distribute summaries and action items.
* Follow up on commitments made in meetings and keep the Owner informed of progress.

***Project Coordination***

* Track many projects at once across merchandising, design, sourcing, production, and sales, and keep them moving.
* Prioritize tasks based on urgency and the Owner's goals and escalate issues before they become problems.
* Serve as a liaison between the Owner and department heads, vendors, and customers.

**Qualifications**

Required: A Strong Understanding of AI

This is the most important qualification for the role. The Owner understands AI well and is looking for someone who does too: a person who knows how AI tools work, what they do well, where they fall short, and how to apply them to genuine business problems. Basic familiarity with a chatbot is not enough.

* Solid understanding of how AI tools work, including their strengths, their limits, and common errors such as confident but incorrect answers.
* Hands-on, regular use of AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or Gemini for real work, not just casual experimentation.
* Ability to write clear prompts and judge AI output, checking it for accuracy before relying on it.
* Experience using AI to draft, summarize, research, analyze data or automate routine tasks.
* Awareness of the current AI landscape, including new tools and how businesses are putting them to use.
* Ability to keep up with an AI-savvy Owner, discuss AI tools and ideas at his level, and turn them into practical processes for the business.
* Understanding of the basics of responsible AI use, including protecting confidential and personal information.

**Required: Experience and Skills**

* Proven ability to manage many projects at once and prioritize under pressure.
* Personable, warm, and professional, able to build relationships with team members, vendors, and customers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Advanced skills in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint) or Google Workspace, since this role handles all computer-based work for the Owner.
* High discretion with confidential business information.
* Self-starter who anticipates needs and works independently while the Owner travels.

***Preferred***

* Experience in a product-based business such as home furnishings, fashion, consumer goods, or design.
* Experience in merchandising, marketing, or product development, with a strong eye for product, trends, and brand presentation.
* Experience with social media, e-commerce, or digital marketing, including AI tools for content creation and imagery.
* Experience helping a team adopt innovative technology or processes.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Under limited supervision, this position will support the development, implementation, continuous improvement, and evaluation of career advisement initiatives aligned with state priorities and workforce development goals. The Career Advisement Program Specialist will develop resources and guidance, coordinate professional learning, provide technical assistance to schools and districts, monitor program effectiveness, and collaborate with internal and external partners to strengthen career pathways and improve student career readiness.

* Identify and vet credentialing and micro-credentialing programs for career advisors.
* Collaborate with the Georgia Professional Standards Commission to develop certification options for career advisors.
* Develop and maintain external partnerships with school systems, postsecondary institutions, business and industry partners, and other education stakeholders.

* Maintain current knowledge of career advisement research and evidence-based instructional practices and develop and maintain related resources.
* Use program and student outcome data to inform continuous improvement.
* Monitor program implementation and effectiveness using relevant data.
Represent GaDOE in state, regional, and national career advisement initiatives to share Georgia’s work, identify emerging practices, and support the continued improvement of career advisement throughout the state.  

Please note that statewide travel is required.

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Preference will be given to applicants who, in addition to meeting the minimum qualifications, possess one or more of the following:

* Experience aligning career advisement with graduation requirements and Individual College & Career Plans (ICCPs).

* Experience developing career advisement instructional resources, implementation guidance, or technical assistance for K–12 educators.

* Experience analyzing and interpreting data.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal communication skills.

jobs.description:
**Based in metro Atlanta. Field-based: you drive between our 18 stores across the Atlanta and north Georgia market. Not tied to one store.**

**About us**
------------

Torpedo Hospitality owns and operates 18 Jersey Mike's Subs restaurants across Georgia, from Marietta and Suwanee to Gainesville, Dahlonega, McDonough and Griffin. A small office team keeps the stores supplied, maintained, inspected and paid on time so the General Managers can focus on their guests.

**Job summary**
---------------

The Operations Coordinator is the office team's person in the field. You'll follow up on store requests, meet vendors and repair techs, check that work was actually done before invoices are paid, keep permits and records current, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks between the stores and the office. It's a hands-on, organised role for someone who likes solving problems in person.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Store support and follow-up**

* Visit stores on a planned weekly route and follow up on open requests, repairs and issues with each General Manager.
* Log and track store requests and maintenance tickets from report to completion.
* Follow up on items flagged in our daily and weekly controls reports (deposits, paid-out forms, temperature logs, opening checklists) and confirm they are fixed.

### **Vendors, maintenance and inspections**

* Meet repair technicians, linen, pest control and other service vendors on site, and confirm the work was completed before the invoice is approved.
* Help stores prepare for health inspections and brand standards visits, and confirm corrective actions are closed.
* Check deliveries, shortages and credits with stores and suppliers, and record what is still owed.

### **Records, permits and admin**

* Keep permits, licences, certificates and store records current and filed, and flag anything coming up for renewal.
* Collect receipts, forms and photos from stores and upload them to the right systems.
* Help with small office tasks: data uploads, simple reconciliations, spreadsheets and vendor follow-up emails.

**Qualifications and skills**
-----------------------------

* 1 to 2 years of experience in operations, administration, facilities, restaurant or retail management, or a similar role.
* Highly organised and reliable: you finish what you start and keep a clear record of it.
* Comfortable with Excel, email and Microsoft 365; quick to learn new apps.
* Clear, friendly communicator with store teams, vendors and the office.
* Reliable transportation, a valid driver's licence and willingness to drive between stores across metro Atlanta and north Georgia most days.

**Preferred experience**
------------------------

* Restaurant or multi-unit retail experience.
* Experience coordinating vendors, maintenance or inspections.

**Schedule**
------------

* Full time, Monday to Friday, daytime hours, with occasional early or late visits.

**Compensation and perks**
--------------------------

* Competitive pay, discussed at interview.
* Mileage reimbursement for travel between stores.
* Paid training and free and discounted Jersey Mike's meals.

**Why join us?**
----------------

* See the whole business, not just one store.
* A growing, locally owned team where good organisation is noticed.
* Room to grow into a larger operations role.

Our authentic taste – served Mike's Way® with lettuce, onions, tomatoes, oregano, salt, and THE JUICE (oil and vinegar) – is called our CRAVEABILITY factor. Our secret? Everything about Jersey Mike’s is the absolute highest quality, including our employees. Our USDA Prime Roast Beef is trimmed and cooked right here in the store. Our meats and cheeses are all top-quality premium brands sliced freshly before your eyes. Our bread is fresh-baked each day on premises. And of course, everything’s created right in front of you. It’s what makes Jersey Mike’s the most authentic tasting submarine sandwich available, truly a \Sub Above\, and it’s a tradition of quality we’ll never outgrow. Our team is just that as well...an amazing group of people working together, having fun, engaging with our customers and making each visit memorable with our unique, friendly, and welcoming personalities.

Pay: $40000.00 - $60000.00 / year

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Paid training
* Mileage reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Dental insurance

Job Type: fulltime

Schedule:

* Monday to Friday
* Day shift

Education: No education required

Work location: On-site

jobs.title: Local Store Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Based in metro Atlanta. Field-based: you drive between our stores and prospects across the Atlanta and north Georgia market. Not tied to one store.**

**About us**
------------

Torpedo Hospitality owns and operates 18 Jersey Mike's Subs restaurants across Georgia, from Marietta and Suwanee to Gainesville, Dahlonega, McDonough and Griffin. Every one of our shops is part of its neighbourhood: we feed the offices, schools, teams, car lots and stores down the road. We're looking for someone to make sure every one of those neighbours knows we can feed their people.

**Job summary**
---------------

We're looking for an energetic, outgoing and results-driven Local Store Marketing Coordinator to grow sales at our 18 stores by building relationships in the communities around them. The role is about revenue: catering orders, repeat business accounts and local visibility that turns into sales you can see on a ticket.

This job suits someone who loves meeting people and knows every visit, call and follow-up has one goal: bring new business into our shops and turn it into regular customers.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Business development and community sales outreach**

* Visit businesses, offices, schools, medical practices, car dealerships, big box stores, distribution centres and community organisations near our stores, with the goal of winning catering orders and repeat accounts.
* Find and get to know the people who order food: office managers, HR teams, store and sales managers, event coordinators, coaches and school administrators.
* Present our catering menu (Subs by the Box, boxed lunches, trays and platters) and our ordering options, including ezCater and online ordering, in a way that ends in an order, an account or a booked follow-up.
* Build and work a pipeline of prospects for each store, from first contact to completed order.

### **Catering and revenue growth**

* Generate new catering and large-order leads and turn them into recurring business.
* Promote staff lunches, employee appreciation meals, team and field-trip lunches, holiday and seasonal crew meals (such as Black Friday), training days and large event orders.
* Follow up consistently with prospects, past catering customers and lapsed accounts to win repeat orders and long-term relationships.
* Work with each store's General Manager so the store is ready to deliver large orders on time and to standard.

### **Local store marketing (sales-focused)**

* Hand out catering menus, flyers and offers as part of a targeted plan for each store, not general canvassing.
* Run sampling, tastings and drop-offs designed to open an account or drive an immediate order.
* Support local promotions and community events that bring measurable traffic and sales into the stores.
* Keep local listings and partner programs current where they bring in orders (for example, community and employer discount programs).

### **Catering partnerships**

* Build trackable catering partnerships with schools, booster clubs, sports teams, churches, nonprofits and employers: game-day and team meals, staff and teacher appreciation lunches, event catering and standing orders.
* Every partnership should be measurable in the point-of-sale system, with orders that can be traced to the account that placed them.
* Work with store leadership to schedule and deliver partnership orders and events that add revenue.

### **Pipeline management and reporting**

* Keep our outreach tracker up to date with every visit, contact, lead, account and order.
* Maintain an organised contact list of local businesses and community partners by store.
* Prepare weekly call and visit lists with store GMs, and report progress, wins, challenges and next steps to management every week.

**Qualifications and skills**

jobs.description:
Advertising Sales Representative Analyst | Early Career | Full time

Job No. R00374926 | Atlanta, GA

  

We are seeking an experienced Advertising Account Manager to manage and grow a portfolio of SMB advertisers on an emerging advertising platform for a global AI company.

You will combine consultative selling with hands-on campaign expertise, helping advertisers develop their strategy, launch effective campaigns, understand performance, and scale their investment. You will own client relationships from onboarding through ongoing account development, with responsibility for advertiser retention, revenue growth, and long-term success.

  

This role requires practical experience creating, managing, and optimizing digital advertising campaigns, ideally across paid social platforms. You should be comfortable advising multiple clients, diagnosing campaign challenges, and turning performance data into clear recommendations. As the platform develops, you will also help shape effective ways of working, capture advertiser feedback, and build approaches that support a growing advertising business.

What You Will Be Doing

Account Management & Advertiser Growth

* Own and develop a portfolio of SMB advertiser accounts, building strong relationships with decision-makers and becoming a trusted advertising advisor.
* Understand each client’s business model, audience, commercial objectives, and marketing priorities, translating these into tailored advertising strategies.
* Develop account growth plans with clear objectives, campaign priorities, testing opportunities, and next steps.
* Lead regular account reviews, explaining campaign results, highlighting opportunities, and agreeing actions to improve performance.
* Identify early signs of disengagement or churn and take proactive steps to address concerns and retain advertisers.
* Grow advertiser investment by demonstrating value, recommending relevant opportunities, and helping clients scale campaigns against their business goals.
* Manage expectations clearly, particularly as the platform’s capabilities and advertising offering evolve.

Campaign Strategy, Creative & Activation

* Consult with advertisers on campaign objectives, audience strategy, budgets, creative messaging, and measurement.
* Guide clients through onboarding, campaign setup, and launch, helping them establish a clear foundation for ongoing optimization.
* Apply experience from paid social and digital marketing to advise clients on effective ad copy, creative concepts, formats, and calls to action.
* Help advertisers develop creative testing plans and identify opportunities to refresh or improve their ads.
* Recommend structured tests that help clients learn what works and make informed decisions about future investment.
* Adapt recommendations to the capabilities available on the platform and each advertiser’s level of experience.

Campaign Diagnosis & Optimization

* Monitor campaign performance and identify issues affecting delivery, engagement, conversion, or return on investment.
* Diagnosing potential causes of underperformance, including creative quality, audience relevance, budget allocation, campaign setup, and the post-click customer journey.
* Interpret advertising metrics such as impressions, click-through rate, cost per click, conversion rate, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend, where available.
* Turn performance insights into prioritized recommendations, explaining what should change, why, and how success will be assessed.

* Work with relevant internal teams to resolve technical or delivery issues and keep advertisers informed.
* Track the impact of recommendations and use results to guide subsequent optimization and scaling decisions.

* Handle objections through informed discussion of campaign strategy, performance, and business outcomes.

* Meet agreed standards for lead response, advertiser follow-up, account reviews, and renewals where applicable.
* Document campaign recommendations, client commitments, growth opportunities, and retention risks.

* Contribute to playbooks and processes that improve advertiser onboarding, campaign support, and account growth.
* Follow advertising policies, quality standards, and data privacy requirements in all client interactions.

**Atlanta, GA.**

**Come Make the World With Us**

  

**The Job:**

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. Continuously evolve and understand the competitive landscape in order to secure target channel position

Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs.

* *Belong:* Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for a wide range of perspectives and experiences.
* *Give Back:* Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices.

  

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us!

The **Home Depot National Accounts Manager** is a high performing team contributor that serves as a primary point of contact for the Wall Tile and Mosaic portion of the business. This role will be responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with the category merchant(s), IPR, online teams and internal Daltile partners, driving revenue growth, and ensuring overall client satisfaction.

**LOCATION:** **5000 Highlands Pkwy, Suite 280 Smyrna, GA 30082**

* **This role does NOT provide current or future sponsorship assistance.**
* **Please note that we will NOT provide relocation assistance (Candidates are expected to relocate on own 3 weeks from time of offer acceptance).**
* **This is a direct hire role; We are NOT open to employing through contractor or agency.**

**Duties and Responsibilities of the Position:**

* Serve as a National Account Manager supporting The Home Depot, building strong customer relationships and partnering with Home Depot merchants and cross-functional teams to drive sales, operational execution, and long-term account growth.
* Analyze POS, inventory, assortment, competitive performance, and market trends to identify growth opportunities and translate weekly and YTD results into clear, actionable recommendations across Wall Tile, Mosaics, Deco Wall, White Wall, and online channels.
* Lead assortment strategy, line reviews, resets, and SKU productivity, identifying underperforming items, recommending replacements, evaluating expansion opportunities, and supporting new product launches and buybacks from recommendation through execution.
* Develop and execute Home Depot account plans and growth strategies that support revenue objectives, strengthen the company's position with the customer, and identify new business, merchandising, and operational opportunities.
* Manage inventory and supply-chain execution for the account, proactively monitoring in-stocks, order activity, upcoming expansions, and project requirements while partnering with Home Depot and internal planning teams to address risks and improve visibility to future demand.
* Partner closely with Planning, Marketing, Product, Operations, Customer Service, and other internal teams to execute Home Depot programs and ensure inventory, samples, displays, product, POP, and supporting materials align with customer timelines and expectations.
* Conduct in-person and virtual customer meetings and sales presentations, presenting recommendations, programs, pricing, business opportunities, and account performance to Home Depot stakeholders.
* Provide regular updates and high-quality analysis to senior leadership on Home Depot performance, key opportunities, risks, market dynamics, and recommended actions to support short- and long-term account strategy.
* Make informed business decisions based on a strong understanding of The Home Depot, company objectives, competitive activity, industry practices, and market trends, continuously identifying opportunities to improve performance and execution.
* Operate as a collaborative team player, communicating effectively across the Home Depot account team and broader organization, sharing information, supporting team priorities, and contributing to the overall success of the account.
* Work collaboratively from the Smyrna, Georgia office as part of the Home Depot account team, with the ability to participate in in-person customer meetings, internal meetings, and other business activities as required.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as needed to support The Home Depot account and broader business objectives.

* 4-6 years relevant experience or equivalent education and/or experience.
* 2+ years of experience in account management or field sales preferred.

**Competencies:**

* Requires in-depth conceptual and practical knowledge in own job discipline.
* Strong negotiation and contract management skills.
* Excellent communication, problem solving, and organizational skills.
* Strong presentation skills
* Able to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively.
* High level of integrity and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential data.
* Proficient using Microsoft Office Suite products.
* Flexible attitude, adaptable to change, team player, and able to handle multiple projects at once.
* High degree of professionalism, judgment, maturity, and resourcefulness in the absence of formalized guidelines and procedures.

**Other Pertinent Job Information:**

* The ability to lift 50 pounds regularly.
